description:
Analista de Segurança da Informação - GVUL

Na EY, estamos comprometidos em moldar seu futuro com confiança. Nós ajudaremos você a ter sucesso em um ambiente globalmente conectado, repleto de equipes diversas, e a levar sua carreira para onde você desejar. Líder em serviços de inovação e um centro de excelência em Cybersecurity, oferecendo soluções operacionais adaptadas às necessidades de seus clientes. A equipe trabalha em projetos diversos, unindo talentos de toda a América Latina para desenvolver soluções inovadoras que enfrentam desafios complexos. Ao ingressar na área de Cybersecurity, você contribuirá para a proteção de ativos tecnológicos e fará parte de um ecossistema que valoriza criatividade e inovação, participando da transformação digital. Venha para EY e ajude-nos a construir um mundo de negócios melhor.

Sobre a oportunidade:

Você assumirá as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar e monitorar vulnerabilidades utilizando a ferramenta ServiceNow, com foco em VR for Application.
  • Realizar triagem e priorização de vulnerabilidades, utilizando métricas e relatórios gerados pelo ServiceNow.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o cliente para entender suas necessidades e oferecer soluções eficazes, minimizando a dependência de solicitações constantes.
  • Participar de reuniões e discussões técnicas, contribuindo com insights e recomendações para melhorar a postura de segurança.
  • Desenvolver e utilizar Power BI para análise de dados e relatórios de segurança, facilitando a visualização e interpretação das informações.

Requisitos e habilidades que buscamos:

  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas de Tecnologia.
  • Certificações desejáveis: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist - Vulnerability Response, CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+.
  • Conhecimento em Tenable, PowerShell, JavaScript, Python, Linux e outras linguagens.
  • Experiência prática com o módulo ServiceNow Vulnerability Response para gerenciar e responder a vulnerabilidades.
  • Familiaridade com SIEM (Security Information and Event Management), como Splunk ou IBM QRadar, para análise de eventos de segurança.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de vulnerabilidades, como Nessus, Qualys ou Rapid7.
  • Conhecimento em inglês ou espanhol é um diferencial.

O que oferecemos:

Acesse go.ey.com/beneficios e conheça nosso universo de benefícios. Na EY, você se desenvolve com habilidades voltadas para o futuro e se abastece de experiências de classe mundial. Nós capacitaremos você em um ambiente flexível e potencializaremos seus talentos extraordinários em uma cultura diversa e inclusiva, com equipes globalmente conectadas. Pelo 4o ano consecutivo, a EY está na lista do Great Place to Work como uma das melhores empresa para se trabalhar, com destaque para as categorias de diversidade. Você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Você gostaria de moldar seu futuro com confiança? Inscreva-se hoje!   • Provide technical guidance and support to operations, maintenance, and engineering teams as required.

description:
Descrição da empresa

Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir-faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free-minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

Sofitel, a global reference in French luxury hospitality, announces the transformation of Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema into its first flagship hotel in Brazil, with an expected opening by the end of 2026.

Located on Ipanema Beach, the hotel will feature 172 rooms and embody the brand’s contemporary vision of luxury, experience, and service excellence.

Descrição da vaga

We are seeking an accomplished Executive Chef to lead our culinary operations, crafting exceptional dining experiences across 7 outlets. This is a unique opportunity to shape the gastronomic vision of a landmark property, managing a high-performing team and delivering world-class cuisine in a dynamic luxury environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Culinary with advanced certifications;

  • Deep knowledge of food safety, sanitation, and compliance standards;
  • Exceptional leadership, mentoring, and team-building skills; thrives under pressure in fast-paced luxury environments;
  • Passion for creating unforgettable dining experiences with the highest standards of quality, creativity, and innovation;
  • Commitment to cultivating a positive kitchen culture and introducing signature and seasonal concepts that define the hotel’s culinary identity;
  • Fluent in Portuguese, English and French with excellent communication skills.

  • Experience in implementing wellbeing and development programs that enhance employee engagement and growth.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with leaders and employees.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
Com mais de 6 mil funcionários em mais de 20 países, a Statkraft é uma empresa norueguesa, com ações pautadas pela ética e transparência. É líder em energia hidrelétrica internacionalmente e a maior geradora de energia renovável da Europa. O grupo produz energia hidrelétrica, energia eólica, energia solar, energia a gás e fornece aquecimento urbano.

No Brasil a empresa tem sua sede localizada na cidade de Florianópolis, em Santa Catarina (SC). Atualmente, controla 26 ativos de geração renovável no Brasil. Em novembro de 2023, a Statkraft assinou a compra da Enerfín, subsidiária renovável da espanhola Elecnor, que inclui nove parques eólicos em operação nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul e Rio Grande do Norte. Dessa forma, a empresa tornou-se uma das maiores geradoras de energia eólica do Brasil, ultrapassando a marca de 2.2 GW de capacidade instalada, entre aquisições, construções e operações no país.

A empresa é pioneira em oferecer energia renovável rastreável com garantia de origem no Brasil, certificando, por meio do I-REC (Certificado Internacional de Energia Renovável), a origem da produção de sua energia, o que garante que a operação é sustentável.

Descrição do emprego

Responsável por implementar e acompanhar processos de RH nas áreas sob sua Diretoria/Vice-Presidência, incluindo Arquitetura Organizacional, Performance & Sucessão, Comitês de Talentos, Remuneração e Benefícios, Pesquisas de Engajamento, Treinamento e Programas de Desenvolvimento. Atua como parceiro estratégico das lideranças, influenciando e apoiando a gestão para fortalecer ambientes seguros e alinhados aos valores e competências da organização.

  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das lideranças, apoiando no desenvolvimento da gestão e engajamento das equipes;
  • Influenciar e facilitar o desenvolvimento de executivos e gestores, acompanhando planos individuais e evolução de competências;
  • Apoiar na definição e estruturação de cargos, análises salariais e estudos de remuneração para tomada de decisão;
  • Planejar e implementar ações de capacitação, desenvolvimento de lideranças e gestão de talentos (comitês, sucessão, carreira);
  • Apoiar na gestão do clima organizacional, pesquisas de engajamento e planos de ação para melhoria contínua;
  • Elaborar relatórios e books gerenciais com dados estratégicos para suporte à tomada de decisão das lideranças;

Qualificações

Graduação em Psicologia,AdministraçãoouEngenharias;

Pósgraduaçãoem áreascorrelatas ;

Sólida experiênciaem RH e seus subsistemas;

Português Brasileiroe Inglês fluentes;

Experiência no setor de energia elétricae comercializadoras.

Informações Adicionais

Conosco, você desenvolverá uma trajetória profissional com oportunidades incríveis. Isso inclui:

  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional em vários níveis da organização, incluindo LinkedIn Learning, programas e ações de desenvolvimento;
  • A chance de fazer parte de uma organização verdadeiramente global, composta por profissionais competentes, inovadores e responsáveis, de diferentes países e culturas;
  • Uma cultura organizacional que cuida e respeita as pessoas, oferecendo soluções de trabalho flexíveis, princípios de equilíbrio entre vida profissional.
  • Assistência médica e odontológica para você e seus dependentes.
  • Previdência privada, com contrapartida por parte da empresa.
  • Vale alimentação/refeição.
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos até 7 anos.
  • Auxílio para pais e mães com filhos com deficiência.
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, respectivamente 6 meses e 20 dias.
  • PAS – Programa de Apoio Statkraft, serviço profissional com psicólogos, assistentes sociais, advogados e consultores financeiros.

O que é fazer parte da Statkraft?

É contribuir para um planeta mais verde e sustentável. Ser Statkraft é renovar a energia que impulsiona o mundo: uma energia limpa, inspiradora, com ética, integridade e segurança.

Fazer parte da Statkraft é inspirar pessoas a escrever a nossa história, com acolhimento e respeito à diversidade em toda a sua plenitude.

Ser parte da Statkraft é vivenciar os nossos valores, é ser competente, responsável e inovador. É ter uma comunicação aberta e transparente.

Compromisso com a diversidade

A visão da Statkraft é renovar a forma como o mundo é movido. Para navegar essa jornada complexa, precisamos de todas as vozes à mesa. Por isso, trabalhamos ativamente para ser um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo, e damos boas-vindas a todos os candidatos, independentemente de origem, gênero, idade, orientação sexual, crença religiosa, etnia, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Nosso processo seletivo é contínuo , o que significa que não há data limite para envio de candidaturas. Enquanto a vaga estiver publicada, seguimos avaliando novos perfis.

Para se candidatar, envie seu currículo através de nossa plataforma. Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the project controls discipline. The Senior Project Controls Specialist solves complex problems and uses their discipline‑specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Project Controls Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the project controls team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, or Financial Analysis within an EPC or project‑driven environment
  • Proficiency in general office productivity tools, particularly spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation software
  • Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, and performance measurement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while also leading collaborative efforts across global, multidisciplinary teams

  • Fluent in English with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and deployment of advanced visual analytics to support project performance monitoring, forecasting, and executive‑level reporting
  • Apply data mining, statistical modeling, and trend analysis techniques to identify key performance indicators, cost drivers, and schedule risks across complex, multi‑phase projects
  • Integrate and link data from multiple internal and external sources to build robust, multi‑dimensional models that support real‑time decision‑making
  • Architect scalable data structures and implement standardized methods for data transformation, validation, and automation across project controls systems
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—including engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and IT—to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data solutions
  • Interpret complex data requests and deliver clear, accurate, and insightful outputs that align with project and organizational objectives
  • Provide strategic insights by identifying correlations, anomalies, and emerging trends within large datasets to support proactive project management
  • Guide and mentor junior team members on data governance, reporting standards, and best practices for data management, storage, and security
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools based on historical data, current trends, and scenario planning to support long‑term project planning and risk mitigation
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital project controls tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with global EPC standards and practices
  • Lead or contribute to the development of internal training materials and knowledge‑sharing initiatives to elevate data literacy and project controls capabilities across the organization
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, client requirements, and industry standards in all aspects of data handling and reporting.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in project data analytics, guiding Project Managers, Cost Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders on data‑driven decision‑making

Estamos formando o nosso Banco de Talentos para Supervisão de Lojas Próprias no Zé Delivery!

Se você é uma pessoa que gosta de liderar times, garantir eficiência operacional e busca constantemente a excelência nos processos, essa é a sua oportunidade de ficar no nosso radar para futuras posições na área de Operações DTC.

Aqui, valorizamos quem é mão na massa, tem perfil de dono(a) e gosta de construir resultados com propósito. Ao se inscrever, seu perfil ficará registrado para futuras oportunidades alinhadas ao escopo de Supervisão de Lojas Próprias e Operações de Campo no Zé Delivery.

Sobre a área de OPERAÇÕES:

O Time de Operações é o responsável por organizar o ecossistema e garantir que o cliente seja atendido sempre com excelência. E para fazer a conexão desta área com a necessidade do cliente, existem as equipes regionais que fazem a gestão dos pontos de vendas, e desenvolvem a melhor forma de aplicar o planejamento com o a visão local. Como Supervisor de Lojas Próprias, você será responsável por:

  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança e boas práticas operacionais;
  • Realizar o controle de estoque (inventário, contagens e conciliações)
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de nível de serviço (KPI’s), propondo planos de ação;
  • Liderar e desenvolver o time local, garantindo engajamento e performance.
  • Gerir os parceiros logísticos e garantir o desempenho das operações de entrega;
  • Garantir os processos de loja (5S, paletização e ressuprimento)
  • Realizar a gestão de despesas, custos e receitas
  • Garantir a manutenção das lojas

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação: Ensino Superior Completo.

Pré-requisitos da função:

  • Experiência em gestão de equipes e/ou liderança de operações;
  • Excel avançado, Power Point

Strategic & Executional Abilities

Other Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

  • Passion for SEM and digital marketing, with a test‑and‑learn mindset
  • Willing to accept challenges and be a pro‑active problem solver

Benefits

  • Salary range: 50k to 70k USD annually

title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Customer Relations
description:
Senior Manager, Ticketing Customer Relations

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Ticketing Customer Relations Senior Manager is responsible for supporting the definition and implementation of the comprehensive Ticketing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) strategy in close collaboration with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management. Serving as the primary liaison in the host country, this role oversees the entire Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country, providing mentorship and direction and ensuring that all managers and staff meet established objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reporting operationally to the Team Lead Ticketing CRM, acting as the primary Ticketing CRM liaison in the Host Country with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project.
  • Overseeing and managing the performance of the Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country through the implementation of effective processes, KPIs, service levels, escalation paths, and quality‑assurance plans.
  • Coordinating with other ticketing teams and FIFA functional areas to ensure cohesive and effective project delivery.
  • Handling all types of escalations with a solution‑oriented approach, ensuring efficient resolution of complex cases while keeping FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management informed.
  • Leading the identification, mitigation, and resolution of risks and issues and responding to major customer‑impacting incidents to minimise operational impact and reputational risk.
  • Ensuring the effective delivery of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy, including ticketing rules, policies, procedures, pricing, and ticket products, in line with legal requirements and ticketing objectives, ensuring fair and transparent access to tickets for as many fans as possible.
  • Overseeing sales data and demographic analysis to support the ongoing refinement of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy.
  • Translating the overall Ticketing Strategy into clear, actionable requirements that guide delivery across all Ticketing CRM functional areas.
  • Ensuring an efficient and optimised customer experience by defining and implementing the end‑to‑end customer journey for both general public and group sales customers, identifying service gaps, and implementing improvements across all channels.
  • Planning and implementing effective customer care for all ticketing customers, including organising and implementing automated customer‑care solutions for general public customers and ensuring high‑quality one‑to‑one support for both general public and group sales customers.
  • Ensuring full compliance with data protection laws, ticketing rules, terms, legal requirements, and internal policies, including the enforcement of internal control measures and access‑control policies.
  • Managing RFPs and service provider relationships to ensure external partners are contracted in a timely manner and meet all obligations related to service quality, processes, and customer data.
  • Overseeing Ticketing CRM reporting on customer care performance and trends, using data insights to enhance proactive communication and improve the overall customer experience.
  • Planning and delivering all ticketing sales collaterals and communications, and overseeing customer communications by planning, approving, and coordinating emails, notifications, FIFA.com content, FAQs, and manuals, ensuring mandatory legal documents are accurately presented and that tone and accuracy are consistently maintained, while ensuring proactive communication reduces the need for one‑to‑one support.
  • Ensuring the effective gathering of requirements for ticketing systems and communication channels and overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to guarantee system performance and readiness.
  • Ensuring effective communication channels for proactive communication and customer care for both general public and group sales customers.

YOUR PROFILE

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record in large scale customer relations management within complex, high‑volume ticketing or major event environments; demonstrates strong leadership capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast‑paced, multicultural, and highly regulated environment.

Key requirements include:

  • Significant experience in customer service or ticketing operations within sports organisations or other high‑volume environments.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritise, plan, and deliver under pressure and within tight timelines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams and external stakeholders, including headquarters‑level entities, service providers, and technical teams.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The ideal candidate will bring experience in some of the following areas:

  • Expertise in defining CRM strategies, customer journeys, and service delivery frameworks to optimise the end‑to‑end customer experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex customer issues and coordinate cross‑functional responses to high‑impact incidents.
  • Solid understanding of data protection requirements and internal accountability processes to ensure full compliance with legal and operational standards.
  • Proficiency in managing RFPs and service‑provider relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret performance trends and translate data insights into actionable operational improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to oversee customer‑facing content, ensure accuracy and consistency, and support proactive communication strategies.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise and deliver complex workstreams within tight timelines.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders, demonstrating cultural awareness and high levels of discretion.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, communication channels, and User Acceptance Testing processes.

title: Accreditation Operations Senior Manager
description:
Accreditation Operations Senior Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. The tournament requires a highly coordinated, secure, and reliable accreditation operation across all venues and official facilities. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Accreditation Operations Senior Manager plays a senior operational leadership role within the FIFA27 Accreditation team, overseeing the coordination and delivery of accreditation operations across the tournament footprint. He/She will be responsible for the end-to-end planning, coordination, and delivery of accreditation operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring consistent, compliant, and high‑quality service delivery across all tournament venues and official facilities.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager, and working in close collaboration with FIFA Zürich Accreditation, Technology, Security, Client Groups, and Venue Operations, the role provides operational leadership, governance, and oversight of accreditation centre operations, badge production and distribution, accreditation venue teams, and service delivery standards.

The role provides oversight and guidance to Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators and acts as a senior operational escalation point.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Planning & Management

  • Manage the overall accreditation operations strategy across all tournament venues and facilities
  • Define and implement accreditation operational policies, procedures, workflows and service standards in alignment with FIFA requirements
  • Establish and maintain operational timelines, resourcing plans, and risk mitigation measures.
  • Contribute to tournament readiness activities, including operational testing and scenario planning.

Venue & Facilities Management

  • Plan and oversee the delivery of fully equipped Accreditation Centres, including overlay, FF&E, technology, power, lighting, and connectivity.
  • Supervise the setup, operation, and dismantling of accreditation centres and badge distribution points.
  • Ensure venue teams are trained, resourced, and aligned with central accreditation policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate the Accreditation volunteers planning, including shift structures and service levels.
  • Supervise daytoday accreditation centre operations across all venues and facilities.

Badge Production & Distribution Oversight

  • Define requirements and manage procurement of accreditation consumables in line with FIFA27 Inc. standards and timelines.
  • Oversee badge production, quality control, secure storage, logistics, and distribution.
  • Implement robust stock controls, audit processes, and reporting mechanisms across all accreditation facilities.

Team Leadership & Support

  • Lead and manage a team of Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators.
  • Support and guide venue‑based accreditation managers, temporary staff and volunteers.
  • Provide training, coaching, and performance oversight to ensure consistent service delivery and operational excellence.

Issue Resolution & Stakeholder Support

  • Act as the final escalation point for complex operational issues related to badge issuance, access rights, or client service.
  • Work closely with the Accreditation Systems, Client Group Managers and Coordinators, Security and Technology teams to resolve operational challenges efficiently.

Compliance, Security & Governance

  • Ensure all accreditation operations comply with FIFA access control policies, data protection requirements, and security protocols.
  • Support venue zoning implementation and access rights validation.
  • Ensure accurate documentation, secure handling of materials, and operational compliance at all times.

Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track operational performance and provide regular operational updates to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to postevent reporting, lessons learned, and operational debriefs.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Experience

  • University degree or equivalent higher education in Event Management, Operations, or related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in accreditation and/or major event operations.
  • Proven experience managing venue operations and large‑scale logistics in complex event environments.
  • Familiarity with accreditation systems and access control processes.
  • Experience working in multi‑lingual, high‑pressure environments.
  • Experience with FIFA or major international sporting events or with accreditation Systems is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong operational leadership and coordination skills.
  • Excellent organisational and logistical planning skills.
  • High attention to detail and operational discipline.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross‑functional coordination skills.
  • Ability to operate calmly and decisively in time‑critical situations.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Project) and planning tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Knowledge of 3D modelling or planning tools is a plus.

Additional Requirements

  • Eligibility to work in Brazil.
  • Willingness to relocate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the contract.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours during critical operational phases.

title: Coordenador(a) de Segurança do Trabalho (Projetos e Obras)
description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.

Descrição da Vaga

  • Estamos em busca de um Coordenador(a) de Segurança do Trabalho, com forte atuação em campo, para coordenar e garantir a excelência em Segurança do Trabalho nas obras de grande porte da NTS, envolvendo projetos de alto CAPEX, múltiplas contratadas e frentes simultâneas. Este profissional será responsável por assegurar a integridade operacional, a prevenção de riscos e o cumprimento dos requisitos legais e corporativos de SST nos canteiros de obras.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar presencialmente em campo, acompanhando frentes de serviço e garantindo conformidade com diretrizes corporativas de SST.
  • Coordenar a implementação de programas, normas, procedimentos e planos de Segurança do Trabalho aplicáveis às obras.
  • Realizar gestão de riscos (APR, PT, bloqueios, análise de atividades críticas etc.).
  • Acompanhar atividades críticas e atuar preventivamente na mitigação de riscos.
  • Conduzir investigações de incidentes e elaborar relatórios técnicos com planos de ação.
  • Engajar equipes operacionais, líderes e contratadas por meio de treinamentos, campanhas e diálogos de segurança.
  • Monitorar indicadores, elaborar análises e reportar periodicamente à liderança.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas, externas e fiscalizações regulatórias.
  • Atuar como referência técnica em SST junto às áreas de Engenharia, Operações, Projetos e contratadas.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia com Pós-Graduação/Especialização em Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Experiência sólida em obras de grande porte (civil, industrial, infraestrutura, montagem etc.).
  • Vivência com múltiplas contratadas e atividades simultâneas em campo.
  • Domínio das NRs aplicáveis a ambientes de obra.
  • Experiência com Projetos de CAPEX elevado.
  • Pacote Office avançado.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em campo e viagens recorrentes.

Diferencial

  • Vivência no setor de gás natural.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com Gestor Mediato: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Benefícios

  • Auxílio farmácia
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day-off de aniversário
  • TotalPass

Aqui, você será parte de uma empresa sólida, com propósito claro e que valoriza o bem-estar, o respeito. Venha transportar o futuro conosco!

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Você será responsável por liderar iniciativas de otimização da taxa de conversão, atuando como elo estratégico entre dados, tecnologia e negócios. Sua missão é identificar oportunidades de melhoria nas jornadas digitais dos usuários, propor hipóteses fundamentadas em dados e executar testes que impulsionem resultados mensuráveis.   • Forte habilidade de comunicação com áreas de negócio, traduzindo dados técnicos em recomendações estratégicas compreensíveis e acionáveis;

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Project Director provides day-to-day operational and strategic implementation leadership for the ASCEND-AI initiative, a multi-year, multi-institution collaboration between Howard University and Bowie State University focused on advancing AI literacy, responsible AI use, faculty development, curriculum infusion, and student application pathways. This role is responsible for translating the project vision and grant goals into coordinated action through faculty learning communities, collaborative workshops, curriculum module infusion, and student-facing activities. The Project Director ensures that activities are well planned, executed on schedule, and aligned with the approved workplan and budget, while supporting continuous improvement in partnership with project leadership and evaluators. The Project Director does not conduct evaluation but plays a critical role in enabling responsive implementation informed by evaluation findings.

Supervisory Accountability

None

Nature And Scope

The Project Director is essential to ensuring ASCEND-AI’s ambitious goals translate into real, coordinated outcomes. By connecting planning to execution through faculty learning communities, curriculum infusion, workshops, and student application pathways, this role enables the project to move beyond theory into sustained impact across institutions.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Strategic Planning and Program Execution
  • Lead operational planning to ensure ASCEND-AI goals are achieved through:
    • Faculty Learning Community (FLC) sessions
    • Curriculum module infusion across disciplines
    • Three annual collaborative workshops
    • AI Use Competitions and student application activities
  • Translate high-level project goals into clear timelines, milestones, and execution plans.
  • Coordinate with PI and Co-PIs to ensure consistency between vision, planning, and implementation.
  • Ensure activities across Howard University and Bowie State University align in scope, pacing, and intent.

Faculty Learning Communities and Curriculum Infusion

  • Coordinate logistics, scheduling, and documentation for Faculty Learning Communities.
  • Support FLC facilitators in aligning sessions with project goals related to AI literacy, responsible AI use, and discipline-specific integration.
  • Track progress of curriculum module infusion across participating courses.
  • Ensure faculty development activities remain practical, accessible, and aligned with instructional realities.
  • Support knowledge sharing across institutions while allowing for contextual adaptation.
  • Ensure Faculty Learning Communities and curriculum infusion efforts are structured to support faculty success while minimizing additional administrative or instructional burden.

Workshops, Competitions, and Student Application Pathways

  • Plan and coordinate three annual collaborative workshops, including agendas, speakers, materials, and logistics.
  • Support implementation of AI Use Competitions and other applied learning experiences.
  • Ensure workshops and competitions reinforce project pillars such as human-in-the-loop AI use, ethical reasoning, and applied innovation.
  • Coordinate with partners and facilitators to maintain high-quality, well-run events.

Budget Monitoring and Financial Reporting

  • Monitor project expenditures monthly in coordination with the PI and institutional grants offices.
  • Prepare monthly budget summaries for PI review.
  • Generate quarterly financial reports for:
    • Howard University Grants Office
    • Bowie State University Grants Office
    • ASCEND-AI Advisory Board
  • Track alignment of spending with approved budget categories, including faculty stipends, staffing, curriculum development, workshops, evaluation services, and partnerships.
  • Identify potential budget or resource concerns early and support resolution.

Continuous Improvement and Coordination with Evaluation

  • Participate in quarterly data review meetings with:
    • PI and Co-PIs
    • Project Coordinator

Co-projetado com as participantes, o programa possui uma abordagem holística que, através do esporte, contribui para o seu desenvolvimento e empoderamento. A Empodera –Transformação Social pelo Esporte é uma organização, sem fins lucrativos, com sede no Rio de Janeiro e atuação nacional. Fundada em ****, desenvolve programas e projetos esportivos, com viés educacional, para meninas adolescentes e mulheres periféricas, e capacita organizações de todo o Brasil na criação de espaços seguros para meninas no esporte. Sobre a AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN). A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

title: Principal ROV Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex ROV (Mar)-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal ROV Specialist may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in ROV (Mar). As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee ROV requirements on assigned project
  • Oversee ROV Tooling Requirements
  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies
  • Ensure efficient and excellent integration of the subsea interfaces of the SURF project to the marine operations execution

Deliverables

  • Conduct live audits of ROV contractor's premises/offshore in conjunction with Marine QHSE and provide feedback on system and personnel performance/opportunities for improvement
  • Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines
  • Prepare ROV contractor mobilization audits to ensure readiness/compliance with contract specifications
  • Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status
  • Research and assessment of latest ROV techniques/equipment so MDR remains up to date and for possible inclusion into Marine Operations/standards

Project Deliverables

  • Issue installation procedure for subsea hardware installation/operation
  • Issue equipment/material specifications for remote subsea tooling and installation aids
  • Provide expertise to the project team to review the subsea installation philosophy of the main subsea components (flexible, umbilical, suction pile, manifold, SDU, and flying lead installation) and proper implementation into the installation procedure
  • Provide input to subsea Pre-Commissioning / Commissioning activities for key contractors
  • Manage interface with subsea hardware EPC contractor and review subsea material delivered to enable a smooth integration of all supplied subsea components into the installation method
  • Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
  • Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
  • Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID’s
  • Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

Reporting Structure

Reports to:

  • Functional: Director ROV Operations
  • Regional: MAO and Senior Manager Marine Operations
  • Project/Construction Manager when assigned to the project

Supervises: Ops Engineers/Field Engineers/Draftspersons

Liaises with: All Marine operations personnel, functional managers, Engineering design teams, project engineering, tendering teams, procurement/subcontract coordinators, and clients

Qualifications

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation
  • Good Project Engineering skills and experience
  • Previous knowledge in dealing with ROV and Subsea EPC contractors
  • Good understanding of QHSE
  • Proficient knowledge of technical software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor
  • Proficient knowledge of project software: Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office

About Us

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

description:
About the job

As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration.

You will represent the company in day‑to‑day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills.

At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high‑growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market.

Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper’s value proposition and effectively position our products and capabilities to airline partners.

What your day‑to‑day would look like:

  • Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
  • Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
  • Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them

  • Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience

  • Comfort working in a fast‑paced, evolving environment

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Who We're Looking For

We are seeking curious and intellectually proactive contributors who double‑check assumptions and play devil’s advocate, comfortable with ambiguity and complexity. This flexible, project‑based opportunity is ideal for analysts, researchers, experienced professionals and consultants with strong critical‑thinking skills, and for those open to a part‑time, non‑permanent role.

About the Project

You will create complex, realistic tasks that push frontier AI agents to their limits. Think scattered data, conditional procedures, and genuine domain expertise. You’ll build a detailed version with objective scoring, then write an ambiguous version to train the agent to succeed with less hand‑holding. Real expert complexity only – you’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you have the relevant experience and are ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us!

Apply to this post to contribute to projects aligned with your skills on your own schedule. To begin working in production, you’ll need to complete a qualification step and project onboarding, where you’ll become familiar with the guidelines interface and try your first real task with guidance from our quality team. title: SDR (Sales Development Representative) BRA (Remote)
description:
A Sales Development Representative (SDR) plays a critical role in driving revenue growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers for the company’s products or services. As the first point of contact in the sales process, SDRs are responsible for creating a strong pipeline of opportunities that fuels the success of the sales team.

This role involves researching and segmenting target markets , identifying decision-makers within organizations, and using multiple outreach channels—such as cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn messaging, and social media engagement —to connect with prospects. SDRs must understand each prospect’s industry, challenges, and goals to effectively tailor their pitch and communicate the value proposition of the company’s offerings.

Beyond initiating contact, SDRs qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring that account executives receive prospects who are ready and able to engage in meaningful sales conversations. They also schedule discovery calls, product demos, or meetings , and document all interactions in the company’s CRM system to maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline.

An effective SDR is goal-driven, resilient, and curious , able to handle rejection while staying motivated to meet or exceed key performance metrics such as outreach volume, response rates, and conversion rates. Collaboration with the marketing team is also essential, as SDRs often provide feedback on campaign performance and prospect insights to improve lead generation efforts.

Success in this role requires exceptional communication skills , both written and verbal, strong active listening abilities, and the capacity to quickly learn and articulate the benefits of complex products or services. SDRs who excel not only open doors for new business but also build lasting relationships that can lead to long-term customers and sustainable company growth.

description:

Resumo do Perfil do Cargo

  • Assist the Driller in operating drilling and mud circulating equipment as instructed in the well program and in accordance to Company policies and procedures.
  • Actively promote Transocean Shared Values.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Qualified applicants are considered for and treated during employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Reporting

Reports to: Driller

Supervision

Derrickhand, Pumphand, and Floorhand, Rover

Pre-requisite/Qualification

  • High School Diploma (U.S.)/ Proof of Completion of Formal Education or Relevant Craft Certificate (where applicable)
  • Successful Military Discharge – Preferred for U.S.
  • Graduate of Trade School or University where knowledge and training acquired are applicable to job requirements – Preferred
  • Valid medical examination and vaccination certificates
  • Knowledge of all technical calculations required for the safe operation within the drilling operations.
  • Basic computer skills
  • Valid well control certificate per the standard defined on the training matrix.

General Requirements

  • Promotes a Safe and Respectful Work Environment: Proactively promotes and Maintains a healthy respect for open and transparent dialogue between all levels of personnel.
  • Demonstrates care for the safety and well-being of all personnel, at all times. Invests in each person to provide equal opportunity for development and advancement of those qualified, to fulfill their career objectives. Respects the dignity of all personnel and recognizes their merit.
  • Attend and participate in all required Safety and Operational meetings.
  • Participate fully in the annual performance appraisal process, competency assessments based on performance against Operational Discipline requirements.
  • Complete company training requirements for the Assistant Driller job level as per the training matrix, including in local/regulatory requirements.
  • If applicable, the duties and responsibilities in the safety case for this position must be observed.
  • Full participation in emergency drills and respond to emergency situations as per assigned duties on the station bill.
  • Norway Specific: Responsible to follow up on the working environment within the rig department.

Operational Discipline Requirements

  • Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process.
  • This is inclusive of:
    • Understanding and perform the roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre-job meeting.
    • Understanding the hazards associated with the task.
    • Understanding and effectively implementing the control measures required to mitigate identified hazards.
    • Execute all tasks and task steps in a disciplined manner, following the sequence detailed in the relevant procedures.
    • Recognize at risk behavior or conditions during tasks and call ‘Time out for Safety’ when unsure, or when the job does not go as planned.
    • Participate in After Action Reviews to feedback lessons learned from performing the task.

HSE Requirements

  • Demonstrate commitment and leadership in the protection of personnel, the environment, and assets.
  • Coach personnel in the understanding of applicable Company OI & HSE requirements.
  • Ensure work is executed in accordance with Company OI & HSE requirements.
  • Call a Time Out when a real or perceived at risk behavior or unsafe condition is observed.
  • Coach personnel to use WorkSight ENGAGE during the execution of planned work.
  • Use WorkSight COACH during the execution of planned work and daily operations to reinforce Company requirements.
  • Report all incidents, potential hazards, or abnormal situations. Ensure reported situations are acknowledged properly.
  • Ensure the Control of Work process is complied with when planning and managing the execution of work.
  • Ensure major accident barriers / controls are maintained.
  • Ensure safe and organized work areas are maintained.
  • Understand your role in an emergency, as designated in the Emergency Response Plan and Station Bill.
  • Lead or participate in all emergency drills and exercises, as required.
  • Ensure change is properly controlled and managed.

    • Duties

    The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements. When considering assignment of duties for the Assistant Driller, the Supervisor and the Assistant Driller will apply the rules of task planning (CAKES) to determine if the assigned role is appropriate. This means confirming that the individuals involved have the knowledge, skills, and experience to carry out the task, and the task plan complies with policy before they are authorized to proceed.

    Operations/Maintenance

    GENERAL DUTIES

    • Perform the drilling department’s daily checklists, i.e. QHSE checks, Derrick inspection, choke and mud manifold line ups, etc.
    • Maintain accurate BHA record of tubular and tool dimensions (i.e. internal and external diameter, fish neck, handling profiles and serial numbers etc.).
    • Calculate ton-miles on drilling line; maintain an accurate logbook and advise the Driller on the need to slip and cut.
    • Maintain an organized drilling equipment store and tubular and subs inventory.
    • Maintain proper communication with the Driller, Toolpusher, and other department heads.
    • Read and interpret various gauges and meters relating to the drilling operations; assist the Driller in maintaining records and logs.
    • Actively participate in pre-tour meeting with the drilling crew for all drilling operations.
    • Assist and relieve the Driller at the Driller’s console during drilling operations.
    • Assist with the preparation of equipment for impending drilling operations.
    • Organize and supervise the drilling crews for all operations.
    • Assist the Driller during an emergency or well control situation; assist in the well killing operations.
    • Assist in supervision of Preventive Maintenance carried out on drilling equipment.
    • Assist in supervision of repairs on drilling and associated equipment.
    • Assist in running and cementing casing strings, running and retrieving BOPs and risers, and other operations as directed by the Driller or Toolpusher.
    • Monitor mud systems and supervise solids control equipment and mud mixing operation.
    • Assist in the planning, organization and execution of rig move operations.
    • Operate drilling and associated equipment as directed by the Driller, i.e. Top Drive System, mud pumps, BOP and Diverter controls, etc.
    • Know the clients’ rules and Company procedures for well control and blowout prevention.
    • Incorporate the THINK process into all tasks, whether working alone or as part of a team.
    • Participate daily in START process.
    • Ensure subordinate personnel are properly trained in the START process.
    • Call a Time Out for Safety (TOFS) whenever an unplanned hazard or a change in the expected results is observed.
    • Ensure all relevant safety procedures and practices are adhered to during drilling operations, in accordance to the Company QHSE manual.
    • Report any incidents, potential hazards or abnormal situations to the Driller or Toolpusher.
    • Actively participate in weekly safety meetings and pre-tour meetings as required, FOCUS Improvement Process, and all other Company safety management systems.
    • Assist in conducting drilling operations safety drills as and when required.
    • Demonstrate commitment to the Company’s safety policies through leadership and guidance.
    • Ensure that a high standard of hygiene and housekeeping is maintained onboard the rig.
    • Meet the training requirements according to the applicable training matrix.
    • Participate in the annual performance appraisal process.
    • Mentor, coach, develop and train crew members to ensure that they are competent to work at their next job level.
    • Provide leadership and motivation to rig personnel; Apply continuous improvement process.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Technology Value Realization Specialist to join our Technology Strategy & Planning Department (TSPD). TSPD’s mission is to provide high-impact leadership and support across the technology life‑cycle, from strategy setting to value realization and sustainable growth, and partner with corporate and business stakeholders to integrate new technologies into the company’s strategies and investment plans.

Your primary role is to play a central part in the corporate stage‑gate and value realization process. You will provide leadership in the implementation, governance and sustainable capability needed to support full integration, application and continuous improvement of the technology stage‑gate process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the company-wide roll‑out of the Technology Realized Value (TRV) KPI validation and reporting process in partnership with Upstream, Downstream, Finance & Technology Organizations.

  • Provide leadership for scientists, engineers, and other business/functional specialists to enable de‑risking and go/no‑go decisions for R&D projects, ensuring technical‑commercial readiness prior to deployment and value realization.
  • Serve as an internal consultant for project teams on the development of robust business cases, deployment and value realization strategies, including partnering with technical, commercial and business leads to implement robust commercial review process to maximize financial return and strategic impact from R&D projects.
  • Assess technology stage‑gate practices and related activities across the Company, in order to maintain high‑standards and compliance with the Corporate Technology Development General Instructions.
  • Partner with R&D staff and stakeholders in technology, business and supporting functions, in order to ensure alignment across all areas and to support a smooth transition and adoption of the enhanced technology management processes.
  • Provide expert guidance to project teams and technology/executive management on related activities, including business case development, IP and commercial strategy, supply chain development, deployment plans, business models, value realization and related techno‑economics.
  • Support financial reporting for deployed technologies to ensure value capture.

Qualifications

  • You must hold a Bachelor degree in Science or Engineering. An advanced degree (MBA/Finance) is highly desirable.
  • You should have at least 10 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years of experience in commercial technology development and value realization, preferably with some experience in oil and gas, chemicals and related industries.

title: Coordenador de Projetos & Negócios
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Ekotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Project Manager
description:
WELCOME TO SITA AtITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

Overview

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting‑edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don’t just move the world forward—we’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow. Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

About The Role & Team

As a Project Manager you will drive a variety of project initiatives that meets the needs of our customer base. This position offers an opportunity to work in a fast‑paced environment with colleagues and customers located worldwide. Success in this role means you pay attention to detail, be time sensitive, possess influencing skills and enjoy working with others of diverse backgrounds. As LAC team, we manage projects in Latin America and Caribbean countries, the Project Manager will be responsible for leading and delivering complex projects for airports and airline customers, ensuring operational continuity, regulatory compliance, and high service quality in mission‑critical aviation environments.

What You Will Do

  • Lead end‑to‑end project delivery, managing initiatives from inception through successful closure.
  • Manage projects of varying size and complexity while driving scope, schedule, and quality outcomes.
  • Proactively identify, mitigate, and manage project risks, issues, and change requests.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross‑functional and geographically distributed project teams.
  • Track project progress against plans and take corrective actions to address deviations.
  • Communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders, management, and customers to ensure alignment.
  • Maintain strong customer focus, partnering closely to meet project goals and satisfaction targets.
  • Produce clear, accurate project documentation, including plans, status reports, governance updates, and lessons learned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Formal Project Management training; PMP certification is recommended but not mandatory.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in a project management role; experience in the Air Transport industry is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent customer communication skills in English; fluency in Spanish is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of IT services, including Network and Server operations.
  • Proven experience managing multiple projects and programs of varying sizes, complexities, budgets, and deliverables in a commercial environment.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, time management, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders effectively.

What We Offer

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
⏰ Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.
Flex‑Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

description:
Selecione a frequência (em dias) de recebimento de alertas:

Localização: RJ-RIO DE JANEIRO, Rio de Janeiro, BR

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua desde 1932 no Brasil e faz parte do Grupo multinacional Roemmers, com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina.

No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos e cosméticos, atua em dois segmentos: medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.

A FQM, com mais de 1.500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história por meio de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

CASO VOCÊ:

  • Tenha facilidade de relacionamento com diferentes perfis
  • Possua visão orientada a dados
  • Tenha habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita
  • Tenha bom planejamento do tempo
  • Tenha brilho nos olhos e seja protagonista da sua carreira...

Seu lugar é aqui!

REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Comércio Exterior, Administração, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pacote Office avançado (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Domínio de SAP PWCE e sistemas de comércio exterior.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Incoterms, regimes aduaneiros especiais, classificação fiscal e logística internacional.
  • Inglês avançado (fluente para negociações e leitura de documentos técnicos) e Espanhol intermediário desejável.
  • Experiência em operações de importação/exportação, com atuação em empresas de médio ou grande porte.

QUAIS SERÃO AS SUAS RESPONSIBILIDADES?

Responsável por garantir o abastecimento estratégico de insumos, produtos e materiais importados, conduzindo operações de comércio exterior com foco em eficiência, compliance e otimização de custos. Atua como referência técnica na área, liderando iniciativas de melhoria contínua e assegurando a conformidade com os padrões regulatórios e de qualidade da FQM.

E AS ATIVIDADES?

  • Gerenciar processos completos de importação e exportação, desde a negociação com fornecedores até o desembaraço aduaneiro.
  • Realizar cotações internacionais, análise de viabilidade logística e negociação de contratos com fornecedores e agentes externos.
  • Elaborar e revisar documentos de comércio exterior (invoice, packing list, certificados, contratos), assegurando conformidade legal e regulatória.
  • Conduzir reuniões estratégicas com fornecedores internacionais para alinhamento de prazos, qualidade e condições comerciais.
  • Monitorar e controlar pagamentos de impostos, taxas e numerários, garantindo a regularidade fiscal e documental das operações.
  • Prospectar e homologar novos fornecedores internacionais, conduzindo testes e análises técnicas de insumos e produtos.
  • Acompanhar e interpretar mudanças na legislação aduaneira e regulatória, propondo ajustes nos processos internos.
  • Atuar como ponto de apoio técnico para áreas internas, contribuindo com análises e soluções em temas de comércio exterior.
  • Utilizar sistemas ERP (SAP PWCE) e plataformas governamentais (SISCOMEX, Radar) para gestão das operações.

* Todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiências.

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
Overview

UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world’s best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez’s Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people’s lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it!

Responsibilities

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do

You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like

Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

This is a contract position. Up to 40 hours weekly. Remote. Selection Process

Commitment to Inclusion

UN/COMMON is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive and bring their full selves to work.

About UN/COMMON

UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Agency Policy

Recruiting agencies are not authorized to submit candidates for this role. UN/COMMON does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies.
