Descrição da vaga

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a GreatPlacetoWork.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupominorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros. Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Quais serão seus desafios:

  • Elaborar, analisar e acompanhar o fluxo de caixa diário, semanal e mensal;
  • Controlar e executar as operações financeiras diárias, como pagamentos, transferências, aplicações e resgates de investimentos sempre em parceria com a Asset do Grupo;
  • Realizar conciliações bancárias diárias, assegurando a identificação das movimentações;
  • Interagir com instituições financeiras para temas operacionais e financeiros, como contratações de linhas de crédito, convênios de cobranças, pagamentos, conciliações, atualizações cadastrais anuais, abertura e encerramento de contas, negociações de tarifas, investimentos etc;
  • Executar operações de fechamento de câmbio, incluindo remessas de envio ao exterior e compras de moedas estrangeiras;
  • Interagir com a área contábil no processo de fechamento mensal, fornecendo informações, conciliações e relatórios;
  • Elaborar relatórios de caixa mensais, fornecendo informações para Diretoria Financeira e contábil;
  • Elaborar relatórios de investimentos mensais de todas as empresas reguladas do Grupo e enviar ao contábil;
  • Realizar o atendimento as auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo documentação e evidências quando solicitado;
  • Garantir aderência às políticas internas e normas regulatórias;
  • Identificar riscos, inconsistências e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos da Tesouraria.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência na área financeira (Tesouraria);
  • Excel intermediário/avançado (análises, controles e relatórios);
  • Noções de impostos indiretos e retenções (ISS, INSS, IRRF, PIS/COFINS, conforme aplicável);
  • Noções de controles internos, compliance e governança;
  • Experiência em fechamento de cambio e compra de moeda estrangeira;
  • Desejável conhecimento em operações financeiras de investimentos, especialmente no segmento de Seguros.

Será um diferencial se você possuir:

  • Noções dos impactos da Reforma Tributária nas rotinas financeiras (Split Payment);
  • Atuação integrada com áreas fiscal, contábil e financeira;
  • Atuação em ambientes com alto volume financeiro e controles estruturados;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida, presencialmente de 4 a 8 vezes por mês no Centro do Rio de Janeiro. Caso seja colaborador resida fora do Rio, a atuação deverá ocorrer em unidade da MAG mais próxima à residência, na mesma frequência.

Empresa da SIMPAR, hoje faz parte da Movida Participações, criada em 2015 para administrar as operações de Aluguel de Carros, Venda de Seminovos e de Gestão de Terceirização de Frotas de veículos leves.

Estamos estruturando nosso time criativo e buscamos alguém para liderar o conteúdo da marca , conectando campanhas, social media e execução criativa no dia a dia.

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Coordenação de Conteúdo , responsável por liderar a estratégia e a execução de conteúdo da marca, coordenando o time de social e garantindo que campanhas, lançamentos e comunicações se traduzam em conteúdos relevantes, consistentes e de alta performance nos canais digitais

  • Integrar ações com influenciadores e eventos ao plano de conteúdo.
  • Acompanhar métricas de performance (views, engajamento, retenção).
  • Propor melhorias contínuas com base em dados e tendências culturais.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia com coordenação ou liderança de conteúdo e / ou social media.
  • Forte repertório em conteúdo digital e cultura de internet.
  • Domínio de plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels e formatos de short video.
  • Capacidade de transformar ideias e campanhas em múltiplos conteúdos.
  • Boa organização, visão estratégica e capacidade de execução.
  • Facilidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com marcas Gen Z, DNVB ou CPG.
  • Vivência em lançamentos de produto.
  • Experiência com creators, influenciadores ou ativações de marca.
  • Perfil criativo e mão na massa.

description:
O Grupo Top Experience é uma empresa de turismo carioca 360º que nasceu do crescimento exponencial da Top Transfer, empresa de transporte terrestre melhor avaliada no Google e número 1 no TripAdvisor em sua categoria. Somos movidos por pessoas, experiências e pelo desejo de encantar. Nossa missão é conectar pessoas aos seus destinos para que elas colecionem experiências incríveis e belas recordações. Se você acredita no poder do turismo para transformar momentos em memórias inesquecíveis, aqui pode ser o seu lugar?

Quem somos e o que fazemos

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Auditoria e Pós-Venda para antecipar falhas, reduzir prejuízos e retrabalho, monitorar atendimentos e garantir uma excelente experiência ao cliente. Essa pessoa será peça-chave na melhoria dos processos e na integração entre os times operacional, comercial e financeiro, contribuindo diretamente para a lucratividade e reputação da empresa.

  • Identificar inconsistências de tarifário e dar baixa de pagamentos quando necessário.

  • Solicitar avaliações positivas nas plataformas e Google.
  • Realizar atendimento a parceiros, direcionando ao setor responsável quando necessário.

Quem você é

  • Experiência na utilização de sistemas operacionais de reservas, gestão de serviços ou plataformas de booking, demonstrando agilidade em cadastros, alterações, conferências e finalizações.
  • Você já teve experiência com atendimento ao cliente (presencial, telefone ou online).
  • Experiência com auditoria e conferência de processos internos, garantindo correção de informações, padronização de procedimentos e execução adequada dos serviços.
  • Experiência com cotação de serviços e negociação com fornecedores, buscando melhor custo-benefício e garantindo alinhamento operacional.
  • Tem familiaridade com sistemas ou CRM.
  • Experiência prévia no setor de turismo, hotelaria ou serviços com gestão de reservas é um super diferencial.
  • Já trabalhou com organização de informações, cadastros ou conferência de dados.
  • Já precisou resolver problemas ou lidar com reclamações de clientes.
  • Atento aos detalhes para que ninguém fique sem informações importantes.
  • Se preocupar com toda jornada do cliente e com ambiente interno.
  • Comunicação clara e eficaz, sempre com muita educação.

Nossa cultura, O Jeito Agi

E não se trata de dar essa oportunidade para poucos, mas de tornar isso possível para todos. No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.

Presencial

Local : Rio de Janeiro/RJ - Ramos

O que você precisa para se tornar um Agilizado?

Benefícios e facilidade

description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Objetivo do Cargo

Buscamos um Engenheiro Especialista para atuar no desenvolvimento, especificação, melhoria, implantação e suporte técnico aos equipamentos industriais utilizados nas Engarrafadoras de GLP. Este profissional será referência técnica para projetos, operação e instalação de equipamentos críticos, garantindo segurança, confiabilidade, integridade e compliance normativo.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir análises de desempenho, confiabilidade, integridade e segurança dos equipamentos.
  • Elaborar e revisar especificações técnicas, memoriais descritivos, escopos de fornecimento e critérios de aceitação.
  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de substituição, modernização e atualização tecnológica da planta.
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade técnica e análises de risco em novos equipamentos e processos.
  • Propor melhorias para redução de perdas, aumento de produtividade e mitigação de falhas recorrentes.
  • Dar suporte às áreas de Manutenção, Operações e Segurança em temas críticos envolvendo:
  • Carrossel.
  • Bombas e compressores de GLP.
  • Sistemas de enchimento e pintura.
  • Equipamentos pneumáticos ou em áreas classificadas.
  • Garantir alinhamento com normas de segurança, qualidade e compliance regulatório.
  • Interagir com fornecedores nacionais e internacionais para especificação, manutenção, testes e FAT/SAT de equipamentos.
  • Acompanhar execução de obras e montagens, garantindo conformidade técnica e segurança.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Mecânica (CREA ativo).
  • Experiência comprovada em equipamentos para plantas de engarrafamento de GLP, tais como:
  • Carrosséis de enchimento.
  • Bombas de GLP.
  • Compressores de GLP.
  • Sistemas de pintura de botijões.
  • Transportadores terrestres por corrente.
  • Lança de enchimento e equipamentos pneumáticos.
  • Vivência com equipamentos elétricos e mecânicos para áreas classificadas (gás e óleo), incluindo Ex d, Ex e, Ex i.
  • Disponibilidade para viajar.

Requisitos Diferenciais

  • Experiência com gestão de integridade mecânica, inspeções, testes hidrostáticos e avaliação de risco.
  • Atuação com instrumentação, pneumática e automação (válvulas, sensores, PLC, painéis Ex).
  • Capacidade de interpretar e desenvolver desenhos técnicos (AutoCAD, Inventor ou similar).
  • Vivência na implantação de projetos CAPEX, desde concepção até comissionamento.
  • Conhecimento em:
    • Melhoria contínua e metodologia Lean.
    • Análise de falhas (RCFA, Ishikawa, Árvore de Falhas).
    • Normas de segurança funcional (ex.: SIL/ISA).
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais, interação com fabricantes internacionais e suporte técnico.

Informações adicionais

  • Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistência Médica, Odontológica e Gympass.
  • Alimentação de Qualidade: Vale Alimentação e Ticket Refeição.
  • Planejar sonhos: Participação nos Resultados e Previdência Privada.
  • Família: Licença maternidade/paternidade estendida.
  • Desenvolvimento: Universidade Corporativa e Convênios de Aprendizagem.

Creada em 1996, a Lifetex inicialmente produzia apenas produtos a partir do TNT (polipropileno) – touca, máscara, gorro, sapatilha, camisola, avental e conjunto de calça e jaleco – não estéreis. Entre o final de 2000 e início de 2001, a Lifetex engajou-se num projeto pioneiro no Rio de Janeiro, que previa a construção de uma Sala Limpa, investimento em recursos humanos e tecnológicos, além de trabalho incansável da equipe técnica para promover a mudança do tecido convencional para o tecido descartável em seus clientes.

Após alguns anos a realidade tornou-se outra: a Lifetex está presente em hospitais e clínicas de todo território nacional, apostando na personalização de seus kits cirúrgicos como diferencial.

Nada disso teria sido possível se não houvesse a preocupação com a qualidade, atendimento dos requisitos e satisfação do cliente. Os produtos da Lifetex são fabricados dentro de normas rigorosas, seguindo os critérios estabelecidos pela Anvisa. Nosso sistema de gestão de qualidade é certificado na norma NBR ISO 9001 mais atual, assim como nossa produção segue critérios que nos levaram à certificação BPF (Boas Práticas de Fabricação) e controle de produtos para a saúde.

Hoje são mais de 600 colaboradores estrategicamente localizados na planta e em inúmeras regiões do Brasil, regidos por uma gestão democrática e com colaboradores engajados, prezando pela qualidade dos processos e pela satisfação de nossos parceiros.

Nossa missão é desenvolver paramentação cirúrgica de excelente qualidade, proporcionando proteção, segurança e conforto para todas as pessoas.

Nossos principais valores

  • Excelência na qualidade dos produtos;
  • Inovação constante para aperfeiçoarmos nossos processos;
  • Relações humanas baseadas em ética e respeito mútuos;
  • Paixão e comprometimento.

Na GSK, somos movidos por ambições audaciosas para transformar vidas e gerar um impacto positivo na saúde de bilhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Nossas Global Functions estão no centro dessa missão, atuando como pilares estratégicos que conectam todas as áreas da empresa e garantem que nossas operações sejam conduzidas com excelência, eficiência e responsabilidade.

Ao unir inovação, colaboração e uma visão global, nossas funções globais tornam possível o desenvolvimento de nossas vacinas, medicamentos e inovações científicas, apoiando cada etapa do processo até que as soluções cheguem aos pacientes. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de contribuir diretamente para um futuro mais saudável e sustentável, trabalhando em um ambiente onde propósito e impacto caminham juntos.

Como Especialista de Produtividade de Vendas na GSK, você será o ponto focal da Unidade de Negócio para assuntos relacionados à Produtividade de Vendas. Irá interagir diretamente com as áreas comerciais e de suporte, garantindo que a execução em esteja alinhada à estratégia comercial. Responsável por acompanhar a performance por meio de KPIs de execução, correlacionar dados da força de vendas com informações de mercado e gerar insights acionáveis em busca de otimizações. Ainda, irá liderar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, apoia decisões táticas e estratégicas e assegura governança, qualidade de dados e aderência a auditorias internas e externas.

Essa posição poderá ficar baseada no Rio de Janeiro/RJ ou São Paulo/SP.

Suas Responsabilidades:

Esse cargo dá a VOCÊ a oportunidade de liderar atividades chaves para progredir na SUA carreira, algumas delas são:

  • Ser o ponto focal dos times internos e da força de vendas para assuntos relacionados à Produtividade de Vendas, garantindo comunicação clara e priorização de iniciativas.
  • Definir, monitorar e reportar KPIs de produtividade, transformando indicadores em planos de ação.
  • Mapear riscos e oportunidades na execução dos consultores; propor intervenções corretivas e preventivas e escalar riscos operacionais com planos de mitigação.
  • Criar, atualizar e disseminar estudos de targeting e segmentação de HCPs, incluindo otimização de territórios.
  • Trabalhar em interface com o time de Remuneração Variável para garantir que modelos de incentivo estejam alinhados à estratégia corporativa e impulsionem comportamentos desejados.
  • Preparar e conduzir apresentações de performance da força de vendas para liderança e dar suporte a auditorias internas/externas, preparando evidências e implementando ações decorrentes.

Por que VOCÊ?

Suas qualificações:

Estamos a procura de pessoas/profissionais com essas características para alcançar nossos objetivos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência profissional prévia comprovada em Produtividade de Vendas ou áreas analíticas correlatas (reporting/BI/performance de campo).
  • Experiência na indústria farmacêutica; conhecimento em Hematologia e Oncologia será diferencial.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade para transformar informações em insights acionáveis.
  • Clareza para diagnosticar causa‑raiz de problemas complexos e capacidade de definir soluções e planos de ação.
  • Elevado senso de governança para processos críticos, qualidade de dados e conformidade; inglês avançado.

Se você tem um perfil detalhista, é apaixonado por entender pessoas, orientar decisões com dados e transformar a experiência do cliente, e quer trabalhar em uma empresa GPTW, o PASA tem uma super oportunidade para você!

Vaga com aplicação para Rio de Janeiro ou Belo Horizonte

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Mapear e compreender a jornada do cliente (do onboarding ao pós-venda), construindo Mapa da Jornada do Cliente e Mapa de serviço (Blueprint) para identificar fricções, pontos de abandono e oportunidades de melhoria por área
  • Planejar, executar e analisar pesquisas de satisfação e esforço (ex.: NPS, CSAT, CES). Consolidar insights e apresentar relatórios executivos com recomendações priorizadas por impacto e esforço.
  • Monitorar indicadores de sucesso do cliente (ex.: churn, expansão, engajamento, tempo de resolução, FCR, tempo de resposta, adoção de features, health score) em Power BI, construindo dashboards e narrativas visuais para tomada de decisão.
  • Realizar análise de processos ponta a ponta (descoberta, desenho e melhoria contínua) aplicando PDCA, Lean, Kaizen e DMAIC (Lean Six Sigma); conduzir workshops de ideação com Design Thinking e priorização via Matriz Impacto x Esforço.
  • Conduzir diagnósticos de canais de atendimento (chat, e‑mail, telefone, app, web), avaliando tempo de resposta, qualidade, taxa de solução, sentimento e voz do cliente (VoC)
  • Estruturar e manter o backlog de melhorias de CX/CS, fazendo a interface com TI, Produto e Áreas de Negócio; aplicar Scrum/Kanban para planejamento de sprints, definição de épicos, histórias e critérios de aceite.
  • Apoiar e facilitar comitês de experiência e sucesso com toda a gerência: preparar materiais executivos (PowerPoint/Power BI), storytelling dos achados, plano de ação e seguimento das iniciativas; registrar decisões e responsáveis.
  • Desenvolver e validar hipóteses por meio de testes A/B, provas de conceito e pilotos; mensurar resultados, documentar aprendizados e escalar soluções.
  • Interface com a área de curadoria de conteúdos e fluxos de atendimento (base de conhecimento, FAQs, chatbots/URA), alinhando tom de voz e diretrizes de comunicação; promover autossuficiência e redução de esforço do cliente.
  • Atuar como guardião da visão centrada no cliente, influenciando stakeholders, promovendo rituais de CX/CS (Daily/Review/Retrospectiva) e acompanhando a execução até a entrega dos resultados.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação

  • Graduação em Administração, Marketing, Engenharia de Produção, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação/MBAs em CX, CS, Gestão de Projetos ou Analytics são diferenciais.

Experiência

  • Experiência comprovada em Sucesso do Cliente e/ou Experiência do Cliente: condução de pesquisas (NPS/CSAT/CES), mapeamento de jornadas, análise de processos e apresentação executiva a comitês de gestão.
  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e melhoria contínua (PDCA, Lean, Kaizen, DMAIC).
  • Experiência na integração de dados de múltiplos canais (atendimento, produto, marketing) e construção de dashboards em Power BI

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em setor de saúde ou serviços de grande base de clientes.
  • Conhecimento em automação de fluxos (ex.: Power Automate) e gestão de base de conhecimento.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que o PASA oferece

  • Oferecemos Vale-Refeição para você aproveitar em lojas e lanchonetes, mas se você curte cozinhar em casa, pode substituí-lo pelo Vale-Alimentação no mesmo valor ou pedir meio a meio (50% vale-refeição e 50% vale-alimentação), facilitando a vida de quem está 100% remoto ou no trabalho híbrido;
  • Falando em Saúde, oferecemos Assistência Médica, Odontológica e Seguro de Vida em Grupo ;
  • Também oferecemos assistência farmacológica e vacinas ;
  • Para cuidar da sua saúde mental, temos o serviço de Psicologia e Psiquiatria online;
  • Você pode fazer consultas médicas sem sair de casa com a Telemedicina , diversos profissionais da saúde prestam atendimento online de forma prática e rápida;
  • Oferecemos a Valia, que é um Plano de Previdência Privada que visa proporcionar segurança econômica e financeira aos participantes para quando se aposentarem. É composto por contribuições do empregado e da empresa, a patrocinadora.
  • A sua educação e seu crescimento é incentivado aqui na nossa empresa, por isso temos o Auxílio Educacional que oferece uma ajuda nas mensalidades da sua graduação e pós graduação;
  • A educação dos pequenos também é importe e por isso oferecemos Auxílio Creche ;
  • Esse é um assunto no qual não curtimos muito, mas é um benefício essencial, o Auxílio funeral para que você tenha toda ajuda necessária nos momentos difíceis;
  • Mas falando em festa, o Benefício de Natal está aí para fazer a sua ceia de fim de ano ficar mais apetitosa e o melhor, seus filhos e enteados menores de 10 anos também tem direito ao benefício;
  • Oferecemos o benefício Associação ao PASA , o empregado associado assegura o benefício em saúde para si a partir do desligamento da empresa sem justa causa ou por aposentadoria, quando não mais terá direito ao AMS; e possibilita a inscrição de parentes até o quarto grau (consulte condições) como usuários dos planos. Além disso, poderá fazer parte de um Clube de Benefícios bem diferenciado.
  • Para esse momento super especial na vida de uma nova mamãe com a chegada de um bebê, o PASA oferece o Benefício Maternidade com licença estendida até 180 dias
  • E os papais também terão esse privilégio de acompanhar bem de perto seu bebê nos primeiros dias de vida com a licença estendida no Benefício Paternidade , de até 20 dias
  • E para descontrair e relaxar, aqui você tem direito ao Sesc , onde poderá ir à teatros, piscinas e diversos outros eventos divertidos;
  • Aqui no PASA incentivamos a qualidade de vida e para isso oferecemos o Wellhub para que você inicie sua vida fitness e cuide de sua saúde física;
  • Se a empresa fechar o ano no positivo, temos direito ao PGD (Programa de Gratificação por Desempenho)
  • Aqui você tem o Sicoob Coopvale que é uma cooperativa financeira que oferece aos empregados e dependentes do PASA, desde que sejam associados, os mesmos serviços disponibilizados por bancos comerciais com taxas mais justas, como empréstimos, investimentos, seguro auto, de vida e residencial, assistência funeral, previdência privada, consórcios, além de dar descontos aos filiados em estabelecimentos conveniados, como óticas, papelarias, universidades, entre outros
  • Todo mundo faz aniversário, né? Nosso presente para você é um Day Off de Aniversário , para que comemore do jeito que preferir, com quem mais ama;
  • Para o deslocamento para o escritório, oferecemos Vale-Transporte.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como ponto focal estratégicojunto aos marketplaces (iFood, Rappi, Mercado Livree novos parceiros), liderando a relação, acompanhando oportunidades comerciais, mudanças de regras, iniciativas estratégicas e alavancas de crescimento dos canais;

  • Liderar a estratégia de mídia interna dos marketplaces, definindo prioridades, investimentos, otimizações e acompanhamento de ROI/ROAS;
  • Diagnosticar e implementar melhorias estruturaisnos canais, considerando sortimento, precificação, conteúdo, mídia, logística e experiência do consumidor;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês fluente.

  • Experiência com operação demarketplaces (iFood, Rappi, Mercado Livree novos parceiros).
  • Conhecimento da plataforma Magento.
  • Pacote Office avançado, com forte habilidade para estruturar análises e apresentações.

Confira o que você pode esperar:

• Um ambiente integrado, leve e acolhedor, onde a colaboração, o respeito e a parceria fazem parte da nossa rotina.

• Descontos exclusivos nas nossas marcas: Granado, Phebo e Care Natural Beauty — porque quem faz parte também merece aproveitar.

• Parcerias educacionais com instituições como Estácio e Open English , facilitando ainda mais sua jornada de desenvolvimento.

• Programa de Participação nos Resultados , valorizando e reconhecendo quem cresce junto e contribui com nossa história.

• Kit Bebê Granado , um carinho especial para colaboradores que se tornam papais ou mamães, celebrando a chegada do seu bebê com produtos desenvolvidos com o cuidado e a tradição que fazem parte da nossa história.

Escritório no Edifício Vista Guanabara , com uma vista inspiradora que traz mais leveza e bem-estar à rotina de trabalho

Aqui, tradição e inovação caminham lado a lado — e você pode fazer parte disso!

title: Senior Director, Consumer & Shopper Insights Brazil, Latam
description:
Coca-Cola HBC

BRL 80.000 - 120.000

Overview

At The Coca‑Cola Company, insights power growth. As Sr. Director I, Consumer & Shopper Insights – Mexico & Brazil, you will lead the generation and activation of consumer, shopper, and category insights across two of the Company’s most critical and complex markets. Mexico and Brazil represent diverse consumer cultures, highly fragmented retail ecosystems, strong Traditional Trade, rapidly evolving digital behaviors, and significant affordability and executional dynamics. This role translates deep human understanding, advanced analytics, and category foresight into strategies that drive market share, profitability, and long‑term brand relevance across both markets. You will serve as a senior insights leader and strategic thought partner to Marketing, Commercial, Strategy, and Bottling System leadership, while maintaining strong connectivity with the LATAM and Global Insights networks.

What You’ll Do for Us

  • Lead the Consumer & Shopper Agenda for Mexico and Brazil
    • Own the integrated Consumer & Shopper Insights strategy for both markets, aligning to local priorities, category needs, and global frameworks.
    • Provide thought leadership across categories and channels—Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, On‑Premise, eCommerce—grounded in local behaviors and tensions.
  • Translate Human Understanding Into Business Guidance
    • Act as the single point of accountability for consumer, shopper, and category insights, ensuring consistency in frameworks while keeping them locally relevant.
    • Turn human motivations, barriers, and behaviors into actionable recommendations for marketing, commercial, and innovation teams.
    • Influence decisions on portfolio strategy, execution priorities, media focus, and recruitment strategies through insight‑driven narratives.
  • Bring Analytical Excellence and Next‑Gen Insight Capabilities
    • Integrate multiple data sources—syndicated, shopper card, bottler, first‑party digital, and proprietary research—to deliver coherent, holistic insights.
    • Apply next‑gen insight capabilities—developed in partnership with the LATAM Human Insights team—leveraging AI/ML models, predictive analytics, behavioral science, and digital intelligence to translate signals into actionable business opportunities.
    • Leverage digital ethnography, social listening, sentiment AI, and cultural intelligence to detect emerging behaviors and whitespace opportunities.
  • Lead, Inspire, and Build Capability
    • Drive a culture of curiosity and learning across the system, acting as the clear, influential voice of the consumer and shopper to senior leadership and bottler partners.
  • Contribute to the Regional Human Insights Network
    • Share learnings, frameworks, and best practices with the LATAM Insights organization to enhance regional capability.
    • Bring country‑level trends, signals, and insights to the OU to inform broader strategic decisions.
    • Represent Coca‑Cola as a thought leader in consumer and shopper understanding, internally and externally when appropriate.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Behavioral Sciences, Analytics, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in Consumer Insights, Shopper Insights, Market Research, Analytics, Category Management, or Innovation within CPG or related industries.
  • Deep understanding of LATAM retail environments, with strong experience in Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, On‑Premise, and digital channels.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive decisions across complex, matrixed, multi‑market organizations.
  • Strong expertise in Nielsen, Kantar/Worldpanel, shopper data, and proprietary research platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with advanced analytics, AI/ML applications, and next‑gen insights ecosystems.
  • Exceptional storytelling, data visualization, and fact‑based selling skills.
  • Strong people leadership capabilities with a track record of building and inspiring diverse teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, operate with autonomy, and thrive in ambiguity.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish or Portuguese; proficiency in all three is a strong advantage.

What We Can Do for You

  • Iconic Brands in Critical Markets: Lead insights for Coca‑Cola’s two largest and most influential markets in Latin America.
  • Enterprise Level Impact: Shape decisions that influence brands, customers, bottlers, and millions of consumers every day.
  • Exposure to World‑Class Leadership: Partner with Mexico, Brazil, LATAM, and Global leaders across marketing, strategy, and insights.
  • Growth & Learning Culture: Be part of a learning organization that values curiosity, innovation, and bold thinking.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel.   4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s “Visualizations” and that the “Data Pipelines” are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert' : When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. NaM. Dias Branco, acreditamos que a qualidade de vida no trabalho e o desenvolvimento das pessoas são essenciais para o nosso sucesso. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos, bem-estar e um ambiente colaborativo, onde cada pessoaévalorizada. Quer crescer com a gente? Vem!

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.

title: Jr. Operations Project Manager - Brazil
description:
Looking for the opportunity to kick start your career? Are you excited about a job that comes with responsibilities from day one, but also requires you to go out into the field and roll up your sleeves? And do you want to learn how to manage a complete project cycle and build meaningful customer relationships in the meantime? Then you have come to the right place! Ampelmann is looking for a Jr. Operations Project Manager to join the team in Brazil. Interested? Read more on the role below and find out how to apply!

About Ampelmann

Ampelmann makes offshore access as easy as crossing the street. Driven by innovative technology, we are continuously working on impactful projects, while supporting the shift to cleaner energy. Our international and safety minded environment values your well-being, and our culture is built on open communication and mutual respect. With us, you’ll thrive in a fast-growing, global company with endless opportunities for personal and professional development. Working for Ampelmann truly makes a difference!

Read more about Ampelmann here and have an ‘inside look’ here.

About the Operations Americas (AC) team

The Operations AC team is part of the Operations Department and is divided over 3 locations: Houston (USA), Providence (USA) and Rio de Janeiro (Brazil). The US team currently consists out of a Team Lead Maintenance, 3 Operations Project Managers, 2 Maintenance Technicians, 2 OCC engineers and 1 Team Lead crewing. The team in Brazil consists out of 2 Project Managers, a Maintenance Technician and a Crew Change Coordinator. The team is led from Houston by the Operations Area Manager. As a Junior Operations Project Manager, you will have a high degree of responsibility from day one but will receive the necessary coaching and guidance from more experienced Operations Project Managers. The position is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Your role as Jr. Operations Project Manager

As Jr. Operations Project Manager, you are the internal and external point of contact for projects in your region where an Ampelmann system is deployed offshore. For each project you are responsible for the entire project cycle, from the preparation to close-out phase. Your goal is to finish each project on time, and within scope and budget, resulting in a satisfied client. You do this by optimizing the project, visiting clients, visiting the operation, and executing a flawless project administration. Next to this, you are also responsible for coaching the operators that man the systems offshore.

Regular activities

  • Managing daily project operations and liaising with both internal and external stakeholders on all aspects of your projects
  • Preparing, coordinating, and executing (de)mobilisations of systems, attend offshore trials and perform satisfactory client visits
  • Analysing operational challenges, and preparing and executing proposed solutions
  • Responsible for setting up a project plan and taking care of all project administration (budgeting, invoicing, and purchasing).
  • Occasionally getting your hands dirty, e.g. in a coverall on a yard when work on the system in preparation of a project is performed

We ask

  • Higher Vocational Education/BSc/MSc degree (e.g, Technical Business Administration) and 0-2 years relevant work experience
  • Excellent English and Portuguese communication skills, both spoken and written
  • Willingness to travel (30-40% of the work is performed on site)
  • Affinity with project management
  • Analytical skills, high degree of responsibility and accountability, and a pro-active attitude
  • A great work environment with innovative and change-willing aspirations
  • High degree of responsibility, room to grow, and room to have significant impact
  • Monthly gross salary between BRL 5.226 and BRL 7.466, based on your experience
  • Great secondary benefits (e.g., annual bonus, Working from Home policy, unlimited vacation days, and more)
  • Ampelmann Academy for all your personal and professional development needs

Interested?

You can apply until 5 March 2026 by uploading your CV via the “Apply” button on our website. In the week after the closing date, we will let you know if you have been selected for the first interview round. If there is a match after the first interview, you will proceed to the second interview round. Still a match? Then we will offer you the job!

If you have any questions related to this vacancy, please contact Your contact person for this vacancy is Laura Popescu.

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute: Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

Must Haves

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks.
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good To Have

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). This event, hosted in South America in Brazil, offers the opportunity to be part of a workforce creating a unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards. The role will transition into onsite Overlay Venue Manager during the final Event.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and key stakeholders to define, optimize, and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  • Contribute to procurement and tendering processes by preparing technical inputs for RFPs, supporting technical evaluations, and managing overlay contractors and suppliers across assigned venues.
  • Manage change control and budget tracking for venues within the cluster, ensuring scope, cost, and schedule alignment.
  • Coordinate and oversee the flow of technical information, including drawings, requirements, and updates, across all venues in the cluster.
  • Maintain alignment with stadium authorities by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Oversee overlay delivery from planning through construction, operations, and reinstatement, ensuring quality, compliance, and timely handover.
  • Track progress, milestones, and deliverables, providing regular status updates and supporting the resolution of risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Support operational design development by consolidating raw data into compliant base drawings and ensuring consistent coding and naming conventions for effective tracking and change management.

Your Profile

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
  • Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Right to work in Brazil

  • Availability to travel as needed

As the most widely used Linux distribution, Ubuntu underpins the security of the entire internet. Your leadership will be instrumental in addressing emerging threats, developing robust security measures, and ensuring the continued integrity of Ubuntu. This is an opportunity to make a tangible difference and leave a lasting legacy on the digital landscape. The security engineering team's first responsibility is to respond to emerging threats and aim to secure the open source ecosystem for community and enterprise use. Your work will improve the security of millions of people, by addressing potential CVEs and vulnerabilities alongside the lifecycle of Canonical products such as Ubuntu. You will engage directly with our community and customers, as well as coordinating efforts across multiple engineering teams and projects to make this happen.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.

What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Integrations

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta’s long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language.
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, gRPC, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Darkroom has evolved from a boutique design studio to one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising.

We are looking for an experienced Associate Director of Creative who will act as a player/coach, leading a pod of designers and delivering AI‑powered creative direction, marketing design, and UI/UX projects. The role requires deep experience in integrating AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Midjourney to drive creative efficiency and quality.

Reporting to the Director of Creative, you will advocate for design processes and supervise junior designers across paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. Your first 60 days will focus on integrating ChatGPT and AI into the creative workflow and building training programs.

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of designers, initially 1–2 direct reports, providing strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and escalation handling.
  • Conduct weekly one‑on‑ones to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality output, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and deadlines.
  • Collaborate with marketers, strategists, developers, and clients to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal client work processes in coordination with the Director of Creative and provide training and feedback.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Champion AI‑powered work, leading trainings on best practices and building efficient workflows with the Director of Creative.
  • Lead creative direction engagements that transform paid or organic marketing channels with deliverables such as content calendars, creative briefs, and strategic proposals.
  • Lead 1–2 UI/UX engagements focused on branded e‑commerce websites, emphasizing conversion‑focused UX and clarity.
  • Present design and creative direction work to clients, explaining choices based on UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • 3–6+ years of senior‑level design experience, with at least 1 year of people‑management experience preferred; experience in creative direction, marketing design, or responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web, marketing, and branding skills; color theory, hierarchy, composition, typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience working with AI tools and producing client‑ready assets powered by AI outputs (required).
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, design solutions, and execute effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, Variants) essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) required.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is built for A‑players. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring rigor. We hold a high bar for performance but support each other relentlessly.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in business, you’ll thrive here.

Remote‑First Culture

Reliability & Rotating Equipment Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full‑time Expat family relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a reliability/rotating equipment engineer to join the North Ghawar Maintenance Division (NGMD) / Reliability Unit (RU) of the North Ghawar Producing Department (NGPD). The RU’s scope includes condition‑based maintenance, reliability‑centered maintenance, and failure analysis to identify and mitigate potential equipment failures. By leveraging these services, the RU aims to optimize rotating equipment reliability, reduce maintenance costs, and improve overall asset efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal Systems, and gearboxes.
  • Oversee and perform Product Data Management (PDM) services such as vibration analysis and oil analysis to identify potential equipment failures and recommend corrective actions.
  • Develop and implement condition‑based maintenance programs to optimize equipment performance and minimize downtime.
  • Develop and implement reliability‑centered maintenance programs to identify and prioritize maintenance activities based on equipment reliability and criticality.
  • Perform failure analysis on equipment to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions to prevent repeat failures.
  • Perform technical evaluations of new equipment to ensure compliance with industry standards and codes, and to identify potential reliability and maintenance issues.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and codes such as API, ASME, and ASTM for rotating equipment and reliability engineering.
  • Prepare technical reports and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders, including management and operations teams.
  • Perform oil analysis and other predictive maintenance tests to identify potential equipment problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Perform diagnostics on rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, and gearboxes, to identify potential problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain Reliability Unit KPIs such as maintenance cost reduction, MTBF, and MTTR.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in reliability/rotating equipment engineering.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of reliability, including rotating equipment reliability, PDM services, and condition‑based maintenance.
  • Familiarity with rotating equipment diagnostics such as vibration analysis, oil analysis, and non‑destructive testing methods.
  • Hold a vibration analyst certificate Cat‑III.
  • Understanding of industry standards and codes related to reliability, such as API, ASME, and ASTM.
  • Practical experience in reliability engineering or a related field, preferably in the oil and gas industry.
  • Effective analytical and communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, prepare technical reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Awareness of the latest advancements in reliability science and technologies through professional development courses, certifications, workshops, conferences, and memberships in relevant industry organizations.
  • Knowledge of rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal Systems, and gearboxes.
  • Experience with PDM services such as vibration analysis and oil analysis.
  • Familiarity with condition‑based maintenance, reliability‑centered maintenance, and failure analysis.
  • Ability to perform and help with technical evaluations of new equipment.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding technical opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. We invest heavily in talent development and encourage continuous learning through our extensive workforce development programs.

Mid‑Senior level

title: Engineering Manager- Ceph & Distributed Storage
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Ceph & Distributed Storage. The world creates more than 2.5 quintillion bytes of data every day! We want to help teams to store data in open source storage on commodity hardware — safely, cheaply and simply.

Our goal is to make Ceph easy to install, manage and use — from large enterprise data center installations to half‑rack edge sites. We believe that distributed storage shouldn't be hard — and to keep up with the increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we're excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.

What you'll do

  • You will lead a team building a Ceph focused software defined storage solution
  • You will build and manage a globally distributed team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possible
  • You love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

Design the future of decision-making in energy.

Landmark, Halliburton’s technology division, is modernizing a global enterprise platform used by geoscientists and engineers to make high-impact operational decisions.

We are expanding our UX team and hiring for two dedicated roles:

  • Senior UX Designer
  • UX Researcher

These are distinct positions with focused scope, though hybrid profiles with strengths in both areas are welcome.

This is not incremental UI work. It is large-scale UX modernization across complex, legacy and cloud-based applications. You will help elevate product clarity, usability, and trust in deeply technical workflows used around the world.

You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and customers to embed user-centered thinking into roadmap decisions and product execution.

What You’ll Do

If You Are a Senior UX Designer

You will lead the design of complex workflows and deliver end-to-end solutions that raise the craft quality of Landmark applications.

  • Own UX design for major workflows or product areas
  • Translate business and technical requirements into intuitive, scalable design solutions
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished visual designs
  • Apply and extend the Landmark design system; contribute new patterns when needed
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers to align requirements and deliverables
  • Validate designs with users and iterate based on feedback
  • Participate in and elevate design reviews across the organization

If You Are a UX Researcher

You will embed insight into product strategy and modernization efforts, ensuring decisions are grounded in real user needs.

  • Plan and conduct qualitative and quantitative research across complex enterprise workflows
  • Lead usability testing, interviews, contextual inquiry, and journey mapping
  • Identify unmet user needs and opportunity areas within legacy and cloud applications
  • Synthesize findings into actionable insights for product and engineering teams
  • Influence roadmap decisions through evidence-based recommendations
  • Establish scalable research practices within product teams
  • Partner with designers to validate concepts and measure experience improvements

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Senior UX Designer

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating enterprise or technical product design
  • Mastery of interaction and visual design
  • Proficiency with Figma and modern prototyping tools
  • Experience working in Agile environments
  • Familiarity with Angular or React-based systems preferred

UX Researcher

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Factors, HCI, Psychology, or related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Experience conducting research in enterprise or technical domains
  • Ability to translate research into product and business impact
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional product teams

For Both Roles

  • Experience navigating complex technical environments
  • Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills
  • Comfort working in legacy systems undergoing modernization
  • A desire to shape and elevate UX within a global enterprise organization

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Sr. Manager of Business Operations & PMO serves as a key leader within the Enterprise Technology Services division, supporting the execution of strategic initiatives, operational efficiency, and enterprise project delivery. Reporting to the Director of Business Operations & PMO, this role provides oversight of various capital projects, drives operational improvements, and leads a team of project and business professionals to ensure high-quality delivery and alignment with the university’s mission and technology goals. The Senior Manager collaborates with senior leadership, functional departments, and technical teams to promote transparency, accountability, and sustainable success in IT operations.

Supervisory Authority

Project Managers, Visual Identity Manager, Project Coordinators

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff and students both within the department and University-wide. External contacts include vendors.

Principal Accountabilities

Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the intake, prioritization, and delivery of the technology project portfolio.
  • Ensure adherence to PMO standards, methodologies, and reporting practices.
  • Monitor and manage project scope, schedule, budget, and performance across active initiatives.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks and interdependencies.

Business Operations Support

  • Partner with the Director to manage operational planning, budgeting, and resource allocation across the technology organization.
  • Lead process improvements and standardization efforts across IT administrative functions.
  • Support vendor contract management, compliance tracking, and procurement coordination.
  • Prepare business reports, KPIs, and operational dashboards to support informed decision-making.

Staff Leadership and Development

  • Direct and coach a team of project managers, analysts, and support staff.
  • Set performance objectives, provide regular feedback, and promote continuous professional development.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing work culture aligned with the university’s strategic plan.

Strategic Planning & Governance Support

  • Support the Director in executing the strategic roadmap for business operations and project governance.
  • Provide insight and recommendations to enhance operational maturity and service delivery effectiveness.
  • Assist with the development and refinement of policies, processes, and performance frameworks.
  • Serve as a liaison between IT and university stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities and expectations.
  • Facilitate cross-functional meetings, briefings, and status updates for leadership and project sponsors.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and execution
  • Team leadership and development
  • Project governance and delivery excellence
  • Business process improvement
  • Resource Planning
  • Communication and relationship management
  • Highly skilled in the operation of computers, related software applications (Microsoft Applications: Project, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, and Visio) and standard office equipment.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students and customers.
  • Ability to plan, organize and coordinate work with others.
  • Ability to multi-task efficiently and efficiently.
  • Must demonstrate strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with a wide range of constituencies in a diverse community.
  • Extensive knowledge of Project Management methodologies and best practices.
  • Must demonstrate the ability to communicate effectively in writing.
  • Must possess project management, problem-solving, and organizational skills with the ability to manage projects and tasks.
  • Must also demonstrate a strong focus on attention to detail.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree and 6-10 years of related work experience. 12 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications. Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$105,000-$115,000

title: Recruiter, GTM (Remote)
description:
About Clera

Clera is rethinking how top talent finds their next opportunity. We're backed by leading U.S. investors and already work with some of the most respected startups in AI, including Mintlify, Luminai, and Windsurf. Our AI Talent Agent sits at the center of how candidates get matched, qualified, and introduced to world‑class companies. We’re now looking for a Senior Recruiter to help us scale our U.S. searches. This is a high‑impact role where you combine your recruiting expertise with a next‑generation AI workflow and directly shape how modern recruiting works.

Your Mission

Own high‑impact, end‑to‑end searches for U.S.-based roles using Clera's AI platform. You'll be the strategic recruiting partner for our clients: running full cycles, advising hiring managers, and using data and judgment to drive great hires. This is a high‑ownership role in a fast‑moving startup for someone who's comfortable operating independently, pushing back when needed, and making strong calls on talent.

What You'll Do

  • Run full-cycle recruiting for U.S.-based roles using Clera's AI-powered platform.
  • Review AI-generated matches and quickly identify the strongest, most relevant talent.
  • Interview and qualify candidates, then present tight, high‑signal shortlists to hiring managers.
  • Join client calls, clarify role requirements, and provide honest, strategic hiring guidance.
  • Act as a true partner to clients, including challenging unclear or unrealistic expectations.
  • Own candidate pipelines end-to-end, ensuring fast, clean movement through every stage.
  • Give structured feedback to the engineering team to improve matching logic and workflows.
  • Keep candidate notes and process documentation accurate, up to date, and reliable.
  • Prioritize across multiple searches and drive them to successful hires with minimal oversight.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years recruiting for U.S. clients or U.S.-based roles.
  • Proven experience in fast‑paced environments (startup or high‑velocity agency).
  • Strong client-facing presence: clear communication, expectation management, and relationship-building.
  • Excellent English, written and spoken.
  • Ability to work aligned with Pacific Time (PST), including occasional evening or weekend calls.
  • High comfort with tools, ATS, and AI-driven workflows.
  • Sharp judgment on skills, experience, and culture add—not just keyword matching.
  • High ownership, reliability, and the ability to move fast without hand-holding.

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting across multiple functions (engineering, sales, operations, G&A).
  • Background in both agency and in‑house recruiting.
  • Hands‑on experience improving recruiting tools, processes, or products.
  • Success managing multiple searches and high‑volume pipelines in parallel.

Role Details

  • Location: LATAM Remote
  • Schedule: Flexible, 40–50 hours/week aligned with PST

If you love fast‑moving environments, owning complex recruiting workflows, and being measured by real hiring outcomes, we'd like to talk.

você é uma pessoa que ama se conectar com gente e entender a história de cada cliente? aqui na FARM Rio, estamos à procura de quem se identifica com esses valores para fazer parte do nosso time de caixa . buscamos pessoas que se desafiam a criar experiências incríveis em cada atendimento e a colocar o talento em campo para alcançar os melhores resultados, sempre buscando surpreender e encantar em cada detalhe, fazendo viva a nossa cultura: ser gente boa, bom de gente e bom de jogo .

quer fazer parte de um time apaixonado por moda e por gente? vem pra FARM!

  • atender clientes com gentileza e encantamento;
  • finalizar as vendas utilizando o sistema LINX, garantindo uma experiência positiva ao cliente;
  • prestar atendimento online nos canais digitais;
  • responsável por abrir e fechar o caixa, conferindo todas as transações e garantindo que os valores em dinheiro, cartões e outros pagamentos estejam corretos, seguindo os procedimentos financeiros da empresa;
  • gerir, de forma eficiente, o processo de conferência, recebimento e envio de mercadorias;
  • oferecer suporte à gerência em diversas atividades;
  • colaborar para que a loja permaneça atrativa, organizada e encantadora para os clientes.
  • ser responsável pelas atividades administrativas da loja, incluindo:
  • gestão das solicitações de insumos;
  • gerenciamento de contas a pagar;
  • operação de processos de omnichannel;
  • participação em inventários;
  • garantia de pleno funcionamento de processos e equipamentos da loja.
  • trabalhar bem em equipe, com espírito colaborativo e inclusivo;
  • facilidade de comunicação, com gentileza na oratória e “escutatória”;
  • interesse por moda, tendências, boas conversas e paixão pelo que faz;
  • ser uma pessoa dinâmica, flexível, ágil de se adaptar e organizada;
  • ter visão estratégica para entregar resultados e soluções de problemas;
  • domínio de ferramentas digitais e redes sociais;
  • conhecimento básico do pacote office;
  • desejável experiência anterior na função e no sistema Linx;
  • ensino médio completo;
  • flexibilidade de horário.

quem faz parte do time comercial FARM tem direito à:

  • wellz: plataforma de saúde mental e bem estar;
  • assistência médica e odontológica, disponível mediante taxa de adesão e coparticipação de acordo com o uso;
  • política parental estendida: 180 dias para mães, 20 dias para pais;
  • day off, para curtir o seu aniversário;
  • e a melhor parte: descontos em roupas e acessórios da FARM e demais marcas do grupo AZZAS.

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.
