title: Especialista em Planejamento Energético
description:
Sinta a nossa energia!

Somos um time de 16 mil colaboradores próprios, espalhados por 18 estados brasileiros e no Distrito Federal. Aqui, os sotaques se misturam, integração, colaboração e segurança são elementos fundamentais em nosso dia a dia. Atuamos em toda a cadeia do setor elétrico brasileiro, Geração, Transmissão, Distribuição e Comercialização. Juntos, somos essa Neoenergia toda!

Queremos liderar a transição energética no Brasil e ser a escolha número 1 para brasileiros e brasileiras. E faremos isso com pessoas de todos os gêneros, raças, idades, orientações sexuais e com deficiências. Investimos em diversidade, inovação e tecnologias para oferecer a melhor experiência de soluções energéticas conectadas a cada um dos nossos 16 milhões de clientes!

Local de Trabalho

Flamengo/ Rio de Janeiro.

Sua energia será muito importante para:

Liderar a execução de modelos de preço/operação do mercado de energia brasileiro, envolvendo preparação da base de dados e premissas técnicas e regulatórias para execução, bem como analisar/interpretar os resultados da execução dos modelos e compará-los com a operação do ONS e benchmarking externos.

Além da execução dos modelos, seu conhecimento envolve acompanhar os principais KPIs da operação e expansão do SIN, bem como do mercado de energia brasileiro, além de propor premissas fundamentalistas para estudos de evolução do preços de energia no longo prazo.

Atividades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente a execução do processo de previsão de preços/operação do sistema no curto, médio e longo prazo
  • Acompanhar fóruns de discussões, FTs e alterações regulatórias no âmbito do ONS, CCEE, EPE e ANEEL
  • Buscar evolução metodológica das execuções, propondo automações para maior agilidade, eficiência e mitigação de erros
  • Elaborar premissas fundamentalistas da evolução do preço de energia e balanço estrutural no longo prazo (evolução carga, matriz elétrica e limites de intercambio ao longo do tempo)
  • Avaliar a operação e expansão tanto do SIN quanto do mercado de energia brasileiro
  • Projeção de Encargos, GSF e Bandeiras Tarifárias do SIN
  • Prover suporte técnico-analítico para os clientes de Trading, Portfólio, Comercial, Distribuidoras do grupo e Desenvolvimento de Negócios;
  • Elaboração de estudos especiais sobre efeitos financeiros de sazonalização e modulação para as usinas do grupo.

Para fazer parte do nosso time, você precisa ter:

  • Formação Superior Completa em Engenharia, economia ou demais formações com foco em exatas;
  • Vivência avançada na aplicação dos modelos energéticos: NEWAVE, DECOMP, DESSEM ou SDDP, bem como os modelos satélites SMAP, Weol e PrevCargaDessem;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Pacote Office (word, excel, power point).

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Vivência avançada com Linguagens de Programação (Python, VBS, R...);
  • Pós-graduação em Planejamento Energético, Métodos de Apoio à decisão ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento de Regras de Comercialização;
  • Conhecimento avançado de Inglês ou Espanhol.

Para você ficar com a energia lá em cima, confira nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico para cuidar de você e de seus dependentes.
  • Vale Alimentação para fazer aquele mercado reforçado ou Vale Refeição para confraternizar com os colegas no horário de almoço;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados da empresa, o momento mais esperado do ano!;
  • Licença maternidade estendida , para um puerpério com mais tranquilidade;
  • Licença paternidade , para ficar bem perto da sua família nos primeiros dias do bebê;
  • Licença para casais homoafetivos , porque aqui reconhecemos todos os tipos de família;
  • Trabalho Híbrido para colaboradores administrativos;
  • Gympass para você fazer atividade física e ficar cheio de energia;
  • Programa de Idiomas para você poder se aperfeiçoar em outro idioma;

Missão

Ser o owner técnico da automação de fluxos financeiros (n8n) e da camada de dados para dashboards e KPIs, garantindo confiabilidade, rastreabilidade e escalabilidade.

description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a 'deliver fast' mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.

Fully remote position.

Descrição da vaga

Quem Somos?

Você sabia que somos a construtora de maior valorização na bolsa de valores em 2025?

E temos mais de 3 mil Profissionais Cury que diariamente são movidos pelo desafio de realizar o sonho de milhões de brasileiros: a aquisição da casa própria.

Somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos, seja na cadeia produtiva ou na comercialização dos empreendimentos.

Gostou? Prazer, somos a Cury, venha fazer parte da nossa história!

Conheça as nossas etapas do processo seletivo:

  • Inscrição em nossa plataforma e seleção dos currículos
  • Análise dos testes de acordo com o perfil da vaga
  • Bate-papo com o time de R&S
  • Bate-papo com o Gestor da vaga
  • Feedback da sua candidatura

Obs: essas etapas podem sofrer alterações de acordo com a necessidade da vaga.

Ah... pessoas com deficiências são super bem-vindas viu?

Acredita que não preenche todos os requisitos?

Um estudo recente do LinkedIn indicou que mulheres são menos propensas a se candidatarem a vagas se não acreditarem que preenchem 100% das qualificações. Em comparação, homens tendem a se inscrever mesmo atendendo 60%. Aqui na Cury, queremos construir um ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais diversos e inclusivo. Abaixo estão listadas as responsabilidades e atribuições para posição, porém, se você acredita que sua experiência prévia não se alinha exatamente com todos os pré-requisitos, te incentivamos a se candidatar de qualquer maneira caso tenha se identificado com a posição. Você pode ser a pessoa certa e não queremos perder a chance de te conhecer.

Você curtiu? Estamos aguardando a sua candidatura!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Gestão operacional, de empreendimentos e de processos

  • Coordenar os processos de Relacionamento com o Cliente, Backoffice, Comunicação e Gestão de Empreendimentos , atuando de forma integrada antes e após a entrega das unidades .
  • Realizar o acompanhamento assíduo dos empreendimentos , garantindo visibilidade do status de obra, vistorias, entregas, pendências e impactos na jornada do cliente.
  • Atuar diretamente na gestão e liberação de condomínio e IPTU , assegurando alinhamento com administradoras, órgãos competentes e áreas internas, bem como a correta comunicação aos clientes.

  • Garantir a execução, padronização, atualização e formalização dos processos da área, promovendo treinamentos e ajustes contínuos conforme a evolução do negócio.

Gestão de indicadores, performance e riscos

  • Validar, consolidar e reportar indicadores operacionais, gerenciais e estratégicos , incluindo temas relacionados a entregas, condomínio, IPTU e pós-entrega.
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance (SLA, produtividade, qualidade, volumes, riscos operacionais e impactos reputacionais), elaborando análises críticas e planos de ação.
  • Atuar de forma preventiva na identificação de riscos que possam impactar a experiência do cliente, metas corporativas, imagem da companhia ou regularização dos empreendimentos.

Atuação estratégica e apoio à liderança

  • Apoiar a gestão na definição de estratégias, priorização de iniciativas e tomada de decisão , com base em dados, leitura de cenário e acompanhamento dos empreendimentos.
  • Atuar como braço estratégico da liderança , conectando operação, gestão de empreendimentos, indicadores e visão de longo prazo da área.
  • Contribuir ativamente para a evolução da jornada do cliente no pré e pós-entrega , propondo melhorias de processos, comunicação e governança.

Interface, governança e gestão de crises

  • Garantir alinhamento contínuo com áreas de interface (Engenharia, Jurídico, Financeiro, Marketing, Operações, Qualidade, entre outras), especialmente nos temas relacionados à entrega, condomínio e IPTU.
  • Assegurar uma relação estruturada com administradoras, órgãos externos e parceiros , garantindo cumprimento de prazos, acordos e obrigações.
  • Gerir o farol de monitoramento dos empreendimentos , acompanhando status, riscos, desvios e desdobramentos operacionais e estratégicos.
  • Responder pelo acompanhamento, intermediação e condução de casos críticos e situações de crise , com atuação estruturada, analítica e orientada à solução.

Qualidade, auditoria e fornecedores

  • Realizar reportes e acompanhamento junto à auditoria e áreas de qualidade, assegurando aderência aos processos que impactam certificações obrigatórias.
  • Responder pela atração, avaliação, qualificação e gestão de fornecedores relacionados aos processos de sua área, garantindo qualidade, eficiência e aderência às necessidades do negócio.

Experiência em Relacionamento com o Cliente, Pós-Obra, Gestão de Empreendimentos ou áreas correlatas , preferencialmente no setor imobiliário ou construção civil.

Vivência em pré e pós-entrega , condomínio, IPTU, interface com administradoras e órgãos externos.

Experiência em gestão de equipes, indicadores, SLAs e planos de ação. Conhecimento em governança de processos, auditoria, qualidade e gestão de riscos será considerado diferencial. Capacidade de atuar tanto no nível operacional quanto estratégico, apoiando a liderança na evolução da área.

To be the owner of the business, a Company Brand Ambassador and a business leader, accountable for overall store performance. To manage and coach the store team and to ensure succession plans and internal growth.

No Brasil, o Dermaclub é o nosso programa de fidelidade e clube de vantagens para as marcas de Dermocosméticos (La Roche-Posay, Vichy, CeraVe & SkinCeuticals), um ecossistema robusto que conecta milhões de consumidores a nossas marcas e a uma vasta rede de farmácias parceiras. Com uma base de dados de 8 milhões de pessoas, o Dermaclub é um pilar fundamental para a construção de marca, impulsionamento de vendas e aprofundamento do relacionamento com nossos consumidores.

Missão

Como Gerente de Dermaclub no Brasil, você será o proprietário da marca Dermaclub, do programa de fidelidade e da estratégia de CRM, com a missão de desenvolver e implementar iniciativas que elevem a experiência do consumidor, impulsionem o engajamento e garantam a rentabilidade do programa. Sua visão estratégica e paixão por dados, tecnologia e inovação serão cruciais para continuar a expansão e o sucesso deste ativo tão valioso para a L'Oréal Brasil.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão Financeira e de Rentabilidade (P&L): Gerenciar o orçamento do Dermaclub, monitorar indicadores financeiros e garantir a rentabilidade do programa, identificando oportunidades de otimização e crescimento.
  • Desenvolvimento e Implementação Estratégica: Definir e implementar a estratégia geral do Dermaclub, estabelecendo metas claras, KPIs de desempenho e o planejamento orçamentário para todas as iniciativas do programa.
  • Criação de Roadmap Estratégico: Desenvolver um roadmap estratégico de longo prazo para a marca Dermaclub, antecipando tendências de mercado, necessidades dos consumidores e inovações tecnológicas para assegurar a relevância e competitividade do programa.
  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Time: Liderar, inspirar e desenvolver um time multidisciplinar, incluindo profissionais de marketing, tecnologia e dados, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance e colaboração.
  • Liderança Técnica e Operacional de CRM, Dados & Loyalty: Ser o ponto focal técnico e estratégico para todas as ações de CRM, gestão de dados e fidelidade das marcas da divisão, garantindo a excelência na execução e o uso inteligente dos insights para personalização.
  • Gestão e Implementação de Novas Parcerias: Identificar, negociar e implementar novas parcerias estratégicas que agreguem valor ao programa Dermaclub e ampliem os benefícios para os membros.
  • Interface e Negociação com Times Comerciais e de Trade de Beleza Dermatológica: Colaborar de forma próxima com os times Comercial e de Trade para alinhar estratégias, garantir a integração do Dermaclub nos canais de venda e otimizar a performance em farmácias parceiras.
  • JBPs (Joint Business Plans) e Cycle Plan: Participar ativamente da construção e execução dos Joint Business Plans com parceiros estratégicos e do Cycle Plan das marcas LBD, assegurando a sinergia entre o programa de fidelidade e as iniciativas comerciais.
  • Interface LATAM e Internacional da divisão: Representar o Brasil e colaborar com os times regionais (LATAM) e globais da divisão, compartilhando melhores práticas, recebendo orientações e adaptando estratégias globais à realidade local.

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em gestão de programas de fidelidade, CRM, marketing digital e construção de marca, preferencialmente no setor de bens de consumo, saúde ou beleza.
  • Vivência em estratégias de marketing de influência e social, com domínio sobre como influenciadores contribuem para o fortalecimento de marca e geração de conversas.
  • Habilidade para atuar em ecossistemas digitais, com olhar analítico e multifocal, navegando entre áreas como e-commerce, conversational commerce e a economia dos criadores.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, orientado a dados, com experiência na geração de insights acionáveis e no uso de inteligência artificial para otimização de estratégias.
  • Experiência em liderança de pessoas, desenvolvimento de times multidisciplinares e estruturação de frameworks/processos.
  • Perfil flexível e adaptável, com capacidade de transitar entre diferentes áreas e stakeholders, vendo o valor na integração de dados, CRM, construção de marca e experiência do consumidor.
  • Inglês avançado para interface com times regionais e internacionais.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e PowerPoint.

O Que Você Vai Encontrar

  • Possibilidade de crescimento, incluindo carreira internacional;
  • Ambiente inclusivo e diverso;
  • Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas!

Estamos empenhados em garantir processos de recrutamento inclusivos e em defender a contratação e promoção de cada candidato de forma ética e equitativa.

O Grupo proíbe estritamente a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei.

Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

title: Senior R&D Manager
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

Ideal role for an experienced & ambitious scientist within agronomy. As our Senior Research and Development (R&D) Manager you will lead and be responsible for managing our research and development programme relating to deployment of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a carbon dioxide removal technique in Brazil, with a special focus on agronomic trials. You will design, manage and interpret data from experiments in order to effectively monitor agronomic parameters and as well as helping to address fundamental research questions relating to ERW. You will be based in Brazil, with presence onsite at various locations within Brazil when necessary.

The Impact you can make

This role will oversee and manage team members, and you will take ownership over experiments, driving forward our scientific strategy. You lead our reporting on farmer co-benefits and impact metrics, providing robust scientific evidence to support the case for our wider impact. You will play a key role in managing and driving our science strategy and will be expected to maintain and develop relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Core working relationships

Reporting to the VP of Science and Research, you will support and work effectively with all members of the science and operations teams. You will lead and work closely with our Science and Impact Lead and our Agronomic R&D Lead.

Key Responsibilities

  • Management of team members within our agronomy R+D programme
  • Overseeing and planning our agronomy R+D programme, such as the design of experiments and communication with external stakeholders
  • Generating, analysing, presenting, and publishing data from experiments and deployments to wide-ranging and high-profile audiences
  • You will support operations to provide the robust scientific evidence for our farmer pitches and case studies
  • You drive research and the wider science team strategy
  • You manage communications and partnerships with leading researchers globally, with a specific focus on Brazil
  • You will work with flexibility in Brazil, with travel to onsite experiments within Brazil and to visit partners (expectation & benefit)

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • You have, ideally, 5+ years of experience in senior research or research related roles
  • You have extensive experience in research and development and experimental design, with a focus on agronomy or a related field
  • You have a proven track record of previously successful research projects and publications in high quality journals
  • You have worked on successful research projects with a wide range of stakeholders and partners, e.g., from industry, government and academia.
  • You have knowledge of agronomy and agronomic trials
  • You are fluent in Portuguese
  • You have advanced English language skills
  • You are based in Brazil (ideally Piracicaba or Sao Paulo region)

title: Especialista de Automação
description:
Sobre a vaga

NaM. Dias Branco, acreditamos que a qualidade de vida no trabalho e o desenvolvimento das pessoas são essenciais para o nosso sucesso. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos, bem-estar e um ambiente colaborativo, onde cada pessoa é valorizada. Quer crescer com a gente? Vem!

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, que garantem nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo.

Nossa atuação e cultura

Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.

Missão do Cargo

Atuar estrategicamente no desenvolvimento, implementação e otimização de sistemas de automação industrial, garantindo eficiência operacional, confiabilidade dos processos produtivos e desenvolvimento contínuo das equipes técnicas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Elaborar projetos de automação industrial (conceito, básico e detalhado).
  • Desenvolver arquiteturas de controle e supervisão (PLC, IHM, SCADA, redes industriais).
  • Especificar equipamentos, instrumentos e sistemas de automação.
  • Implementar melhorias contínuas visando:
  • Aumento de produtividade
  • Redução de perdas
  • Melhoria de confiabilidade e estabilidade do processo
  • Analisar dados de processo e propor automações inteligentes e soluções digitais.
  • Planejar, orientar e monitorar os serviços de manutenções preventivas, conforme padrões técnicos de manutenção (padrões de atividades críticas), preditivas e corretivas de máquinas e equipamentos;
  • Orientar os serviços de manutenção e instalação, envolvendo máquinas e equipamentos, adequação de layout e instalações mecânica, hidráulicas e pneumáticas, visando ampliar e melhorar a capacidade e produtividade dos equipamentos;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais e das normas brasileiras;
  • Contribuir para elaboração de orçamentos OPEX e CAPEX.
  • Analisar e autorizar permissões de trabalho de risco (PTR) da área da mecânica;
  • Tratar as anomalias focando na identificação das causas fundamentais e prevenção à reincidência;
  • Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento produtivo, TPM (manutenção preventiva total), pré-preventiva, entre outros;
  • Supervisionar a execução de projetos em campo e coordenar equipes internas e fornecedores.
  • Acompanhar cronogramas, custos, escopo e qualidade técnica.
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos técnicos e práticos.
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas complexos durante implantação e operação.
  • Cumprir os requisitos de sustentabilidade, gestão da qualidade, segurança de alimentos, meio ambiente e segurança e saúde ocupacional.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Mecatrônica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica Engenharia Automação, Engenharia de Telecomunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação em áreas afins.
  • No mínimo 6 meses de experiência na área ou áreas correlatas.

Será um diferencial se

title: Planning and Integration Manager
description:
Planning and Integration Manager

Department: Administration

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

This role focuses on coordinating operational planning, integration, risk and issue management, to ensure successful delivery of the tournament, hosted in Brazil.

The Project Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders, including FIFA and FIFA27, host cities, government entities, and venue authorities, to achieve excellence in planning, readiness, and execution.

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the success of one of the most prestigious global sporting events and leave a lasting legacy for women’s football in Brazil and beyond.

The Project Manager will be a key role during tournament time, co-ordinating day-to-day operations at the Tournament Operations Centre and coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues.

Travel and flexibility to work irregular hours may be required due to the nature of the event.

Project Management and Integration

  • Under the direction of FIFA’s Lead of FWWC Portfolio Management based in Zurich, implement the FIFA Project Management framework throughout the planning, readiness, implementation and closure phases of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 project.
  • Assist to implement project management processes and standards within FIFA27.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and venue teams to ensure the integration of operational, venue and client planning activities.
  • Collaborate with Functional Areas (FAs) in FIFA27, Host Cities, and stakeholders to develop and implement comprehensive function and venue operating plans (Project Definitions, Operations Plans and Site Operational Plans).
  • Assist in the development of tournament-wide contingency plans and ensure functional area and venue alignment.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of the master project plan, critical roadmap from a FIFA27 perspective, capturing all key milestones and tasks and the monitoring thereof.
  • Provide strategic and operational support, including tracking progress, risk-issue monitoring, and milestone adherence.

Reporting

  • Assist in the delivery of the Tournament Operations Centre (TOC) structures and systems to facilitate coordination and issue resolution.
  • Provide regular updates and reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders on progress, risks and issues. Help to compile presentations to senior management
  • Compile standardised reports on project progress, risks, and dependencies to ensure alignment with governance structures
  • Data extraction, consolidation and visualisations

Operational and Client Planning

  • Coordinate the development of client and functional operating plans, policies, and procedures using FIFA templates.
  • Assist in the definition and integration of client journey plans in collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Manage the agreement process for client service levels and priorities.
  • Ensure consistency in planning and delivery across competition and non-competition venues.
  • Support Functional Areas in FIFA27 in preparing and maintaining activity and event schedules, monitoring risks, issues, and resource requirements.

Risk Management

  • Enable risk management processes, including identification, mitigation, and escalation of risks and issues across FIFA27.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 31000 standards for risk management.
  • Support the development of strategic contingency plans.
  • Work with Functional Areas in FIFA27 to ensure risks are identified, documented and mitigated effectively.

Operational Readiness

  • Plan and conduct readiness exercises, including simulations, rehearsals, and testing of infrastructure, systems, and processes.
  • Build the capability of functional area and venue teams through tailored readiness activities.
  • Capture and implement lessons learned from readiness activities to optimize tournament delivery.
  • Prepare for tournament time by transitioning into the day-to-day coordination and issue management role within the Main Operations Centre.

Knowledge Management

  • Contribute to FIFA’s knowledge management initiatives, including the Observer Program, debriefs, lessons capture, and post-tournament reporting.
  • Ensure proper transfer of knowledge through documentation, photo capture, and archiving of key materials for future events.

Training and Development

  • Provide training to FIFA27 users on FIFA’s project management methodology and tools.
  • Ensure consistent application of project management principles across the organization.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of event planning and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with various project management methodologies, including Agile and Scrum, is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading complex, large-scale projects, preferably in international mega-events or sports events.
  • Proven track record in developing and executing strategic and operational plans.
  • Experience managing stakeholder relationships across government, corporate, and community groups.
  • Expertise in project and risk management, issue management, operational readiness, and contingency planning.
  • Experience in tournament time operations, including incident management and resolution.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, multi-stakeholder and multi-cultural environments.

Certifications

  • Professional certifications such as PMP, APM, or Prince2 is required.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • Experience with project management tools is an asset.
  • A good proficiency in visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau for reporting.
  • Familiarity with collaboration tools and systems for managing complex projects.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • Excellent technical skills including however not limited to Microsoft Operating systems server including PowerShell scripting, Microsoft SQL Server , Microsoft Azure including Logic Apps, JSON Scripting, REST API.
  • Azure or AWS Certification is desirable.
  • Experience with System Center Orchestrator 2012 or later preferred.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

Equality & Opportunity for All

We are data‑driven and technology‑centric, fueling curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to start your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Performance Marketing Team at Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. It is highly data‑driven and focuses on developing large‑scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable initiatives and channels. The team blends top analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists. Leadership has deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields, fostering a learning environment where you can grow by working closely with experts worldwide.

In This Role, You’ll Get to:

  • Define the marketing strategy for the Flights vertical (outside of pricing).

  • Conduct end‑to‑end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of analysts and managers; participate in hiring and onboarding of new team members.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

It’s Great If You Have:

  • Experience in the online travel or e‑commerce industry.

description:
Quem somos

A Longitude é uma consultoria internacional independente de design e engenharia , especializada em projetos nos setores de energia, marítimo, naval, offshore e renováveis ?. Parte do ABL Group , atuamos globalmente oferecendo soluções técnicas de alta complexidade ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida de ativos, sempre com foco em segurança, qualidade, inovação e sustentabilidade .

Com uma atuação cada vez mais integrada globalmente, a Longitude conta hoje também com um time de engenharia no Brasil , que trabalha de forma colaborativa com equipes internacionais, conectando expertise local ao know-how global do grupo.

Nossa missão, visão e valores

Missão : Entregar soluções de engenharia confiáveis e eficientes, apoiando nossos clientes na execução de projetos complexos com excelência técnica e segurança.

Visão : Ser referência global em engenharia marítima e offshore, reconhecida pela qualidade, inovação e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

Valores :

  • Safety first – segurança sempre em primeiro lugar
  • Technical excellence – compromisso com a qualidade técnica
  • Collaboration – trabalho em equipe e respeito mútuo
  • Innovation – melhoria contínua e soluções inteligentes
  • Integrity & transparency – ética e clareza em tudo o que fazemos

Sobre a vaga

Você atuará como Engenheiro Job Leader da disciplina de Tubulação , sendo o responsável direto pelo desenvolvimento, coordenação e qualidade das entregas de engenharia em projetos de médio e grande porte. Seu papel envolve desde o planejamento técnico das atividades, passando pela liderança da equipe, até a interface com clientes e demais disciplinas, garantindo que os prazos, requisitos contratuais e normas técnicas sejam integralmente atendidos.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Liderar tecnicamente a disciplina de tubulação, definindo escopo, priorizando atividades e distribuindo tarefas entre engenheiros e projetistas, acompanhando produtividade, prazos e qualidade técnica das entregas.
  • Desenvolver, revisar e aprovar documentos de engenharia, incluindo Piping Design Basis, P&IDs, Plot Plans e layouts 3D, Line Lists, Valve Lists e MTOs, Especificações técnicas de materiais, classes de tubulação e suportes.
  • Garantir conformidade técnica e normativa (ASME B31, API, ISO, Norsok, normas do cliente e requisitos de sociedades classificadoras).
  • Gerenciar interfaces técnicas com disciplinas como estrutural, naval, equipamentos, elétrica, instrumentação etc.
  • Acompanhar e revisar modelos 3D de tubulação.
  • Analisar e aprovar estudos de piping stress, suportes de tubulação e soluções técnicas associadas, garantindo integridade estrutural e operacional dos sistemas.
  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto ao cliente, conduzindo reuniões técnicas, esclarecendo dúvidas etc.
  • Prestar suporte técnico a atividades onshore e offshore, incluindo visitas a estaleiros ou embarcações.
  • Promover melhoria contínua, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de padrões internos.
  • Acompanhar cronogramas e marcos técnicos, identificando riscos, propondo soluções e apoiando a gestão do projeto na tomada de decisão.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Diploma em engenharia (Mecânica, Naval, ou similar).
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, indispensável para comunicação técnica e relatórios.
  • Experiência sólida com engenharia de tubulação em projetos de engenharia, offshore, FPSO ou naval.
  • Experiência comprovada liderando equipes técnicas em empresas multidisciplinares.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e eventuais embarques offshore.
  • Conhecimento prático em software CAD/3D (PDMS, SmartPlant/AVEVA, AutoCAD Plant3D, etc.) e ferramentas de análise para tubulação.

  • Ability to translate research into product and business impact
  • Experience collaborating with cross‑functional product teams

For Both Roles

  • Experience navigating complex technical environments
  • Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills
  • Comfort working in legacy systems undergoing modernization
  • A desire to shape and elevate UX within a global enterprise organization

Join to apply for the Staff Security Operations Engineer role at Canonical.

We have opened several senior/staff Security Operations Engineer (SOC) positions, creating a new team reporting to the CISO. The SecOps team is responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies.

What you will do in this role

  • Implement and evolve Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture

  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials

title: Senior Project Manager Travel
description:
Senior Project Manager Travel

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Travel Project Manager oversees strategic travel planning, commercial management, and operations within the complex environment of a multi-stakeholder tournament.

This position plays a key role in ensuring the success of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 by organizing and managing travel projects that provide safe, efficient, and dependable transportation for everyone involved in the event.

Responsible for turning FWWC27 event requirements into practical travel plans, the Senior Travel Project Manager works under tight deadlines and in collaboration with various stakeholders.

Collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence are central to this role, which involves close coordination with the FIFA Global Travel team, other functional departments, host country authorities, and selected travel service providers.

The Senior Travel Project Manager ensures all projects adhere to company policies, service standards, sustainability commitments, and risk management practices. They also anticipate dependencies, address operational risks, and drive progress on key milestones.

By using structured project management methods and competency standards, this role supports consistent outcomes, builds stakeholder trust, and delivers an exceptional tournament experience. Additionally, it contributes to knowledge sharing, ongoing improvement, and planning for future events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic, Commercial & Financial Oversight

  • Ownership of tournament travel budget planning, cost benchmarking, and financial risk mitigation
  • Market benchmarking of airline/charter pricing to ensure competitiveness (RFP)
  • Identification, analysis, and escalation of pricing inconsistencies, capacity constraints, and commercial misalignments with airline and travel partners
  • Contribution to the development of travel rate cards, pricing frameworks, and commercial guidelines

Scenario Planning & Risk Management

  • Development of contingency plans for high level client groups
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risk
  • Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control

Senior Stakeholder & Executive Interface

  • Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership
  • Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness
  • Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments

Data, Systems & Process Governance

  • Oversight of travel-related data accuracy, reporting structures, and decision-support tools used throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Ensuring transparency, traceability, and auditability of travel decisions, supplier selections, and cost structures
  • Contribution to the continuous improvement of FIFA travel handbooks, templates, operational playbooks, and systems

Tournament Scale & Complexity Management

  • End-to-end coordination of high-volume, multi-city charter and scheduled flight operations during tournament time
  • Ensuring consistent service delivery across multiple client groups (Teams, Delegates, Guests, VIPs, Workforce, FIFA/FWWC27 stakeholders)

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry
  • Further education in tourism, event or general management

Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation)
  • Excellent skills in GDS, preferably GDS Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules are a must
  • At least 2 years of experience in project and event management

Skills & Competencies

  • Experience in budgeting and accounting
  • Good negotiation skills
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, additional languages beneficial
  • Practical commercial experience, distinguished geographical knowledge
  • Systemic and analytical thinking
  • Autonomy and sense of responsibility
  • Practical and process-oriented working profile with quality and efficiency
  • Intercultural competencies, Flexibility, adapting working processes to different cultures
  • Strong team player
  • Clear communication skills in different languages
  • Friendly and diplomatic behaviour to customers, team members and working colleagues
  • Capability to promote knowledge transfer with other team members
  • Service-oriented working style
  • Taking initiative and working proactively
  • Speedy delivery of short-term orders, respecting deadlines
  • Vision to predict potential problematical scenarios and anticipate solutions
  • Creativity to solve unforeseen issues
  • Solution-oriented operation

Certifications & Requirements

  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Strong GDS skills, with preference for Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules required

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). For the first time, it is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires an outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly oversee the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Senior Manager, Retail & Licensing

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Retail & Licensing Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Commercial Operations team, and work in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Head of Licensing & Retail and other key individuals responsible for delivering Licensing & Retail efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source, manage licensing domestic partners in coordination, collaboration and liaison with the FIFA Licensing & Retail (L&R) team in Zurich and aligned with the overall global L&R strategy to ensure the presence of a comprehensive, commercial and compelling range of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ licensed products in Brazil.
  • Develop and implement a national strategic licensing & retail plan in consultation and with approval of FIFA Licensing & Retail team in Zurich and aligned with the global Licensing Strategy. This will include planning product assortment, pricing, and distribution channels to maximize revenue and brand exposure in line with the overall Strategy for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA Licensing, Legal, Financial and Commercial Guidelines working with internal stakeholders.
  • Oversee the implementation and manage the approval of all brand executions (licensed products, packaging, pos, etc.).
  • Manage and oversee the production, quality control, and timely delivery of licensed products coordinating with suppliers, manufacturers, and distributors.
  • Analyse market trends, consumer behaviours, and competitor activities to identify new licensing and retail opportunities and optimize sales potential.
  • Manage relationships with retail partners, including brick-and-mortar stores, online platforms, and official FIFA Stores, ensuring brand consistency and driving sales growth.
  • Monitor and analyse sales performance, inventory levels, and consumer feedback to make data-driven decisions and implement corrective actions if needed.
  • Collaborate with FIFA Legal and Brand Protection to enforce licensing agreements, protect intellectual property rights, and prevent unauthorized use of FIFA trademarks.
  • Provide regular reports and presentations on Licensing & retail activities, including sales performance, market insights, and recommendations for improvement, to senior management and stakeholders.
  • Work with the relevant teams in the Brazil entity to stay informed on key milestones, activations, local and domestic implementations.
  • Oversee royalty reporting, ensure timely payment of remuneration and report back to L&R team in HOF.
  • Manage the contract management process via FIFA’s online system (BrandComply) and ensure the licensees adhere to this process.
  • Assist the L&R team in Zurich with the selection and appointment of retail concessionaires.

Your Profile

Education: Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education in Marketing, Business Administration, Product Management.

Experience: Minimum of 7 years of work experience in licensing and/or event retail in Brazil with preference in the sports or entertainment industry. At least 3 years’ experience leading a team.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Solid communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
  • Thorough knowledge Brazilian market, retail, consumer products and sports and entertainment trends
  • Excellent understanding of product development, go-to-market processes, and retail distribution models
  • Positive and can-do attitude
  • Strategic thinker whilst tactical implementor
  • Highly organised and with a structured approach
  • Financial and legal understanding
  • Comfortable working in a cross-cultural and cross functional team
  • Stress resilient and used to working to tight deadlines.
  • Solid understanding of omni-channel retail
  • Understanding of complex stakeholder rights models

Requirements:

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:

Job Overview

We are seeking an LNG Economist to join Strategy & Business Development Division (SBDD) within the Gas Venture Department.

SBDD is responsible for sourcing and developing international gas value chain (upstream, liquefaction, marketing, regasification) investment opportunities. The Division is also responsible for coordinating the execution of these investment opportunities and managing investments post transaction, with an objective of creating a viable, material integrated global gas business by 2035.

Your primary role, as part on the economics modeling team, is to support the commercial business development team who develops the supply side of the LNG business and will lead the economic evaluation of LNG projects in terms of plant investment and offtake trading for investment decision making. Additionally, you will be required to engage with support functions such as Treasury, Group Finance and Strategy & Market Analysis as part of the model sign-off and due diligence process.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide analysis of potential joint ventures and mergers and acquisitions primarily in LNG and Upstream opportunities and responsible economic and financial modeling on an unlevered and levered basis
  • Handle complex deal structures, with the development and interpretation of data used in a highly technical and confidential analysis platform.
  • Provide sound investment analysis advice in support of LNG and Upstream Projects for Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) deals, by leading economic evaluations and financial due diligence in the deal making process
  • Provide professional and technical expertise for the analysis and solution of complex problems in all areas of financial modeling and economic analysis.
  • Validate and review of seller’s models on opportunities related to Upstream and LNG, identify potential problems and recommend solutions.
  • Provide analysis to fully understand and articulate economic value drivers to management.
  • Examine and prepare variance analysis of economic assumptions and high-level technical inputs with functional engagement support.
  • Provide support in preparation of management presentations for progression of deals through the stage gate process.
  • Assist in the formulation and implementation of economic analysis, policies and procedures to prevent or resolve problems and follow-up implemented changes to ensure the problem has been resolved.
  • Ensure that the company standards and processes are reflected in capital projects progression, project evaluations and in analysis of the business and environment through the stage gate process.
  • Train and develop junior professional analysts

As the successful candidate you will have:

  • Bachelor degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or Business. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 15 years of related financial modeling work experience, preferably in an investment banking environment or a major petrochemical or energy industry corporation.
  • You will also have experience with Economic Evaluations, Cash Flow & Variance Analysis, structured finance, project finance and/or financial modeling.
  • You will be able to conduct Monte-Carlo stochastic risk analysis and VB excel modelling.
  • You will also be able to quickly establish credibility in the position and to effectively interact with all levels of management, including senior leadership.
  • You will have the capability to work effectively within a matrix organization and with multi-disciplinary teams.

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Main responsibilities

Realizar atendimentos clínicos e cirúrgicos especializados na área de Urologia, diagnosticando, tratando e acompanhando pacientes com doenças do trato urinário (masculino e feminino) e do sistema reprodutor masculino, promovendo a saúde e o bem-estar dos pacientes de acordo com os protocolos médicos e éticos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar consultas médicas em Urologia, avaliando sinais, sintomas e histórico clínico dos pacientes;
  • Solicitar e interpretar exames laboratoriais e de imagem;
  • Diagnosticar doenças do sistema urinário e reprodutor masculino;
  • Prescrever tratamentos clínicos e medicamentosos;
  • Indicar e realizar procedimentos ambulatoriais e cirúrgicos urológicos, quando necessário;
  • Atuar em cirurgias eletivas e/ou de urgência em ambiente hospitalar;
  • Acompanhar a recuperação e evolução dos pacientes no pré e pós-operatório;
  • Manter registros médicos atualizados e elaborar relatórios quando solicitado;
  • Participar de reuniões clínicas, atividades de educação continuada e treinamentos;

The ideal candidate is a self‑starter capable of managing complex infrastructure that bridges the gap between traditional IT and advanced scientific research applications.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Consortium Infrastructure Management: Design, configure, and manage Azure IaaS, SaaS, and PaaS solutions tailored to the unique R&D needs of the nine‑school consortium.
  • Secure Networking: Create and manage complex Azure networking services (firewalls, VNETs, subnets, VPNs, ExpressRoute) to ensure secure data transmission between consortium members and government sponsors.
  • Identity & Access Governance: Manage Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) to handle cross‑institutional authentication, ensuring researchers from all nine schools have appropriate, secure access to shared resources.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate the rapid provisioning of research environments using ARM templates, Bicep, or Terraform to support fluctuating project demands.
  • Research Computing Support: Configure and manage high‑performance computing (HPC) clusters, containers (AKS), and serverless environments to handle large‑scale data analysis and simulations.
  • Data Stewardship: Manage and support diverse data storage solutions including Azure Files, Blob Storage, and Data Warehousing to facilitate long‑term research data retention and sharing.
  • Performance & Cost Optimization: Proactively monitor Azure resources to ensure peak performance for computationally intensive tasks while optimizing costs across multiple research grants and task orders.
  • Automation & Scripting: Develop PowerShell and BASH scripts to automate data manipulation, transformation, and routine administrative tasks.
  • UARC Compliance: Ensure all cloud deployments comply with FedRAMP, NIST 800‑171, and CMMC requirements essential for government‑contracted research.

Competencies / Qualifications

  • Azure Expertise: Direct experience in the Azure Cloud platform with a focus on architecting solutions for multi‑tenant or collaborative environments.
  • Automation Skills: Strong scripting experience using PowerShell and BASH for environment orchestration and configuration management.
  • Full‑Stack Cloud Knowledge: Advanced experience in IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS implementations, including monitoring and automated recovery.
  • DevOps Integration: Experience in Azure DevOps services, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile processes within a research or academic context.
  • Specialized Knowledge: Familiarity with High‑Performance Computing (HPC) in Azure and meeting FedRAMP/government security benchmarks.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work across institutional boundaries and communicate technical concepts to non‑technical research faculty and stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3 years of hands‑on experience implementing and supporting Azure IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.
  • 3 years of experience with PowerShell, BASH, or Azure CLI.
  • 3 years of experience in Azure networking services within a large‑scale or multi‑site organization.
  • Demonstrated experience with Azure design and management within a complex, fast‑paced environment.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and the ability to work independently.

Education

description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar atividades na especialidade de neurocirurgia, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.

  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista na área
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe
  • RQE em Neurocirurgia
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função

Hospital localizado em Santa Cruz - RJ

Engineering Manager - Feegow (100% remote friendly in Brazil)

Welcome to the good side of tech . You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health‑tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top‑tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end‑to‑end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high‑quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 80 million patients trust us every month. 130,000 specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2,500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup‑mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we’re 100% remote‑friendly (you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro).

Role

As an Engineering Manager in this group, you’ll be fully responsible and accountable for managing your team(s), ensuring predictable, high‑quality delivery with high operational standards. You’ll also actively partner with your Product counterparts and Staff Engineers to shape the direction of our area and the company as a whole. The role reports directly to the Engineering Director.

We are committed to continuous improvement, open feedback, and working efficiently towards our goals. This role provides an opportunity to influence the strategic direction of the area while receiving mentorship and support as needed.

While expertise in specific technologies isn’t required, this is a technical role, and a solid technical background is essential to effectively support the teams.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead and represent ~10 direct reports in total, organized in smaller multi‑disciplinary teams.
  • Provide accountability for all the initiatives of your teams.
  • Work closely with the technical leaders of the group and the area to develop an effective technical strategy.
  • Act as a point of reference for our Leadership team and for the main stakeholders of your teams.
  • Provide guidance, mentorship, and coaching inside the team, through regular feedback and performance assessments.

Qualifications

You’re likely a great fit for this role if you

  • Have a solid technical background related to the whole SDLC and can support and unblock your teams in complex technical discussions.
  • Have experience in modernizing legacy systems to modern architectures as well as leading teams’ ways of working.
  • Comfortable communicating in written and verbal English across global teams.
  • Approach software development with a lean, proactive, and positive mindset, balancing impact and long‑term sustainable development, with a strong accountability for delivering high‑quality solutions.
  • Embrace the “you build it, you run it” philosophy.
  • Believe in continuous learning and improvement.
  • Are driven to lead and nurture high‑performing and healthy teams.
  • Have experience not only mentoring others but also developing future mentors and leaders.
  • Previous experience in consulting is a plus.

Important: Docplanner is an international English‑first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English.

Responsável pelo gerenciamento de equipamentos de infraestrutura Cloud Datacenter e virtualização de funções de rede (NFV), no perímetro de Network.

Principais atividades

  • Executar atividades de configuração, administração e troubleshooting em redes físicas e virtualizadas presentes no ambiente NFVi, incluindo switches L2/L3, virtual switches, controladores SDN e redes overlay/underlay.

  • Documentar rotinas operacionais, procedimentos de troubleshooting e propor melhorias contínuas para aumento da eficiência operacional.
  • Monitorar KPIs e métricas de rede, aplicando tunning, balanceamento e ajustes preventivos para evitar contenções, perda de pacotes e gargalos.
  • Executar troubleshooting de conectividade envolvendo, VLANs, VXLAN, BGP/EVPN, OSPF; Port-channels, VLT/MLAG, STP/ERPS e Overlay/Underlay.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente projetos de evolução da infraestrutura NFVi, como upgrades, migrações e integrações.
  • Colaborar com equipes técnicas para resolução de problemas e melhoria contínua dos ambientes.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Operação e troubleshooting de ambientes virtualizados ou NFVi de médio e grande porte.
  • Vivência com Switches L2/L3 multivendor (Huawei, Dell, Cisco, HPE, Nokia).
  • Conhecimento em redes virtualizadas e tecnologias como: OpenDayLight, SDN Controllers, virtual switches (OVS, vSwitches proprietários), Sistemas de overlay como VXLAN e EVPN e SD-WAN.
  • Diferencial ter participado de troubleshooting de networking em sistemas operacionais de mercado (bare metal e ambiente virtual VMWare).
  • Diferencial possuir conhecimento em automação e scripting, tais como: Shell, Ansible, PowerCLI, Perl e Python.
  • Diferencial possuir conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), com uso de ferramentas como Terraform e Ansible.
  • Diferencial possuir conhecimento em ferramentas de telemetria e observabilidade, tais como: Prometheus, Grafana e ELK/EFK.
  • Diferencial possuir conhecimento em práticas de segurança aplicadas a ambientes virtualizados, incluindo hardening de Switches e Roteadores, gestão de acesso lógico, segregação e microsegmentação de Rede.
  • Diferencial possuir conhecimento em práticas de segurança aplicadas a ambientes virtualizados, incluindo hardening de hypervisors e gestão de acesso.
  • Diferencial possuir conhecimento básico em tecnologias de contêineres e orquestração, como Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Inglês Intermediário (leitura, conversação e escrita).
  • Formação Superior Completa preferencialmente em Engenharia de Telecomunicações, Tecnologia da Informação e Sistemas de Computação. Engenharia de Redes.
